#### `.5.i.7` D0.1 — FIRST-ANALYSIS CACHE-COHERENCE DEFECT found by the D1 instrument, root-caused, FIXED (session #118, 2026-07-14, `PGEN-RGX-0078-0073`): rule summaries computed mid-cycle or at inherited depth were CACHED, making census verdicts call-ORDER-DEPENDENT (60 → 56 from a traversal-order change alone) and able to DRIFT from emission; fix = taint-tracked persistent-cache admission + per-query transient memo + per-body depth reset; ALL 11 artifacts byte-identical at regen (the landed emission was never wrong)

**REPRODUCE (tools-first, caught by the be-alert tripwire):** wiring the D1 FIRST₂ census
changed the DEGENERACY count 60 → 56 with ZERO changes to the level-1 verdict code — a
read-only instrument moved a supposedly-shared verdict. Per-site blockers named the flipped
sites' branches "unresolved FIRST (cycle/depth cutoff)" on rules that resolve trivially from
a fresh query (`quant_bound_core` = plain terminals + digit refs).

**ROOT CAUSE (WHY + WHERE) — TWO context channels leaked into the shared cache
(`first_set.rs::rule_first_set`):**
1. **Visiting-context:** a rule finishing while an ANCESTOR was still on the visiting stack
   may have absorbed the ancestor's cycle-guard `unresolved`; caching that value serves the
   ancestor-context answer to later FRESH queries. 2. **Depth-context:** `depth` accumulated
   ACROSS rule boundaries, so a query starting deep (the D1 second-byte folds) pushed
   mid-chain rules past `MAX_FIRST_SET_DEPTH` ⇒ cutoff-`unresolved` values were cached
   (`quant_bound_core` poisoned exactly this way). Both channels are ORDER-dependent ⇒ the
   census (one global cache, site order) and codegen (per-rule caches, branch order) could
   compute different verdicts from the SAME shared predicate — the P2 no-drift guarantee
   held only by call-pattern luck.
**Soundness adjudication of the LANDED emission (`-0071`):** every poisoned value provably
carries `unresolved: true` (the guard return propagates through EVERY composition arm before
any nullable check), and every consumer treats `unresolved` as always-try ⇒ poisoning could
only SUPPRESS optimization, never emit a wrong guard — **the landed parser was sound**; and
codegen's per-branch fresh-visiting pattern meant its per-rule caches never actually served
a poisoned read at any gate (proven by the regen below).

**FIX (engine-analysis tier, `first_set.rs`):** the query state is now `RuleVisit<T>` —
`visiting` (cycle guard) + `tainted` (markers for in-progress rules whose guard FIRED;
cleared when the marked rule finishes) + `transient` (the per-QUERY memo) + `cap_fired`. The
PERSISTENT caches admit a value only when NO taint marker is live and no cap fired
(context-free by construction); everything else lands in the transient memo — sound within
its query (conservative direction only) and discarded with it. Depth now RESETS at rule
boundaries (a body is a finite tree; cycles terminate via the visiting guard) with an
explicit `MAX_RULE_CHAIN_DEPTH=64` chain cap as the absolute stack bound. **The first fix
attempt (outermost-only caching, no transient memo) HUNG the SV regen for 85 minutes**
(guard timeout kill, exit 99 — cycle-scoped subtrees recompute exponentially without
intra-query memoization); the transient memo restores linearity: SV-scale analysis measured
**2.47s**. Unit pin: `rule_cache_stores_only_context_free_summaries` (the poisoned shape —
querying `inner` then `entry` must equal the fresh-cache truth).

**ADDRESSED (verified):** census DEGENERACY stable at **60** across repeated runs AND across
instrument paths (with/without the level-2 traversal — the original 60↔56 flip is dead);
PREFIX2 resolution unblocked 15 → **23** dispatchable sites (depth-poisoning had suppressed
level 2 too). **NO REGRESSION:** all-11 canonical regen under the fix — **every artifact
BYTE-IDENTICAL** to the post-D0 pins (regex stays `5d8881b2…`; fresh mtimes = the
regen-actually-happened form) ⇒ NO bench required (no artifact changed; the ⛔ protocol
binds parser-changing landings); dual-feature lib suite green (validator consumers now
compute deep chains coherently); cert/gates via the `-0074` battery below.

#### `.5.i.7` D1 STEP-0 — THE FIRST₂ CENSUS INSTRUMENT + MEASURED SURFACE (session #118, 2026-07-14, `PGEN-RGX-0078-0073`): 23/52 blocked sites are TWO-LEVEL (byte-1 → byte-2) dispatchable — the full `\`-family core (`zero_width`/`class_zero_width`/`anchor`/`escape_unit`/`class_atom`/`hex_escape`) — exposure 363 entries / **319 discarded (20.7% of all residual discards direct)**; the `(`-cluster stays blocked at level 2 (byte-3 territory); D1 emission re-priced ≈−6–12% min-basis

**The instrument (read-only analysis, the P2/P1 no-drift pattern):**
- `first_set.rs::SecondByteSummary` + `branch_second_byte_summary` — a node's SECOND-byte
  facts: `second_bytes` (sound over-approximation of every possible second byte of a
  non-empty match), `len1_possible` (some match consumes EXACTLY one byte ⇒ byte-2
  WILDCARD — the branch joins every second-byte arm incl. EOF), `nullable`/`unresolved`/
  `regex_token_derived` mirroring the level-1 carrier. Derivation: quoted terminals
  (`bytes[1]` / len-1 wildcard), regex tokens via the HIR (literal second bytes; classes:
  1-byte chars ⇒ wildcard, multi-byte chars ⇒ continuation-byte over-approximation
  `0x80–0xBF`; concat/alternation/repetition via an at-offset-0/at-offset-1 frontier fold;
  a `min≤max≥2` repetition unions the element's FIRST bytes as second bytes), native
  builtins (`ascii`/`any_char` wildcards, `any_char` + continuation bytes), rule references
  through the same taint-coherent cache discipline as level 1.
- `fusibility_census.rs::site_prefix2_verdict` (pure, unit-tested) + `PREFIX2-CENSUS` /
  `PREFIX2-EXPOSURE` / per-site `[PREFIX2]`+blockers under `PGEN_FUSIBILITY_DUMP_ALL` —
  gates = the P2 gates MINUS first-byte disjointness, PLUS per shared first byte: every
  admitting branch's second-byte facts RESOLVED and the non-WILDCARD members
  pairwise-DISJOINT on byte 2 (wildcards legal, counted, kill-capping). The same
  layout-trust discipline as level 1 (`layout.regex_tokens`).
- 8 new unit pins (escape-alternation second bytes; group-open sequences; len-1 wildcards;
  builtin mirrors; quantified second-repetition FIRST-byte union; bounded-repeat; cycle
  unresolved; the verdict's discriminate/overlap/unresolved/wildcard quadrants).

**MEASURED (the coherent post-D0.1 analysis, on the byte-identical post-D0 parsers and the
post-D0 dumps):**
- `PREFIX2-CENSUS: blocked_top_level_sites=52 prefix2_dispatchable=23 (wildcard_limited=12)`
  — the sites: **`zero_width`(2) / `class_zero_width`(2) / `anchor`(9) / `escape_unit`(7,w3)

  code_lang — the `\`-escape core named by the `-0072` re-census, now MEASURED dispatchable.
- `PREFIX2-EXPOSURE: 363 entries (16.8% of total), 44 committed, 319 discarded` — the

- **Still blocked at level 2:** `atom` (the 16-branch `(`-cluster shares the full `(?`

**D1 EMISSION RE-PRICE (min-basis: discard elimination = fixed per-parse compute):** direct

tournament-protocol elision on the 44 committed entries at singleton subsets. D0's measured

#### `.5.i.7` D1 EMISSION DESIGN (session #119, 2026-07-14 — recorded BEFORE emission; the guard-form refinement of the STEP-0 sketch, with the WHY)

**The increment (engine-analysis tier per the fix hierarchy — no grammar/annotation can
express second-byte derivation; amplifies at regen with minimal emission machinery):
per-branch FIRST₂ PRUNE GUARDS** — the landed `.5.c.2`/D0 guard pattern extended to the
second byte. `first_set_prune_guard_for_branch` gains a LICENSED second conjunct:
`parse_start + 1 < input.len() && matches!(b[parse_start], F₁…) &&
matches!(b[parse_start+1], F₂…)` (the un-licensed form stays byte-identical to today's
level-1 guard). At end-of-input (`parse_start+1 == len`) a licensed branch is pruned —
correct because the license requires non-nullable ∧ ¬len1_possible ⇒ a match needs ≥2 bytes.

**⚠️ DEVIATION FROM THE STEP-0 SKETCH — FLAGGED WITH THE WHY (the
`feedback_stick_to_agreed_plan` record):** the STEP-0 sketch drew a NESTED two-level
`match` dispatch (byte-1 subset arm → byte-2 arm, tournament verbatim in the final
subset; singleton subsets inheriting the P2 protocol elision). Refined to GUARD form on a
tool-established soundness fact the sketch missed:
- `furthest_position` is written at RULE ENTRY ONLY (`ast_based_generator.rs:3613`
  rule-method preamble; ditto the P1 `inlined_frame_call` helper) — never by
  terminal-match progress. A byte-2-refuted branch that ENTERS a rule/builtin/inlined
  frame at offset ≥1 (the `hex_escape = "x" hex_escape_short_payload` shape) records
  `parse_start+1` on the failing attempt; pruning it would change rejected-parse
  `furthest_position` — a CONTRACT surface (ParseOutcome + the differential-equivalence
  gate compare it). So the license is per-BRANCH, not per-SITE — and only the guard form
  lets a partially-licensed site keep its licensed members' kills.
- Guard form additionally: (i) tournament verbatim BY CONSTRUCTION (zero
  selection-semantics emission surface); (ii) needs NO byte-2 pairwise-disjointness — it
  also fires at sites the nested model rejects (the numeric byte-2-collision families:
  each branch's own guard still kills refuting inputs); (iii) zero body duplication (the
  nested form replicates every wildcard member's body into every byte-2 arm); (iv)
  composes with the P2 byte-switch unchanged (P2 is checked first; fully-degenerate sites
  keep the elided emission).
- FORGONE (recorded honestly): the singleton-subset tournament-protocol elision on the
  census's 44 committed entries — small against the 319-discard surface; re-openable as a
  D1-iii increment if the residual re-profile names the protocol. The director's D1
  semantics — "dispatch on the head byte(s) to the branch subset admitting it, tournament
  verbatim within the subset" — are preserved: the guard IS the subset-membership test.

**Soundness (two independent legs):**
1. SELECTION: license requires resolved ∧ ¬nullable ∧ ¬len1_possible ∧ byte-2 ∉
   `second_bytes` ⇒ no match of length 0, 1, or ≥2 exists ⇒ the branch loses every
   tournament it enters today by failing within its first two bytes; pruning preserves
   winner, positions, and AST — the `.5.c.2` argument applied at level 2.
2. FURTHEST-PARITY (the NEW license leg): a refuted attempt can never consume offset 1
   (consuming it requires a unit whose span covers offset 1, whose declared second/first
   byte would contradict the refutation), so the ONLY observable side channel is a
   furthest write from a rule-entry at offset ≥1. New carrier flag
   `SecondByteSummary::offset1_rule_entry`: sequence fold = at0-element's own flag ∪
   (at1-visited element ⇒ `contains_rule_reference_shallow`, over-approximating and
   sound — an at-offset-1 ATTEMPT of any alternative/optional inside the element may
   enter a rule even when it fails); rule references resolve through the body under the
   D0.1 taint-coherent cache discipline; quoted terminals and regex tokens (atomic
   native matches) are `false`; `unresolved()` is conservatively `true`. License =
   `¬offset1_rule_entry`. REJECTED alternative (recorded): emulating the counterfactual
   bump (`furthest = max(furthest, parse_start+1)`) — a refuted attempt does not always
   REACH its offset-1 entry (a preceding in-branch alternative can die at byte 1), so
   emulation can OVER-advance ⇒ unsound in the opposite direction.
**Shared-predicate discipline (the D0.1 census-vs-emission-drift lesson):** the license
lives in `first_set::branch_prefix2_guard_bytes` (the codegen predicate, mirroring
`branch_dispatch_first_bytes`); the census's byte-2 WILDCARD classification adds
`offset1_rule_entry` so `PREFIX2-CENSUS`/`PREFIX2-EXPOSURE` reflect emission reality.
Expected post-license surface (grammar-shape reading, re-MEASURED below before bench):
the `\`-family core keeps FULL coverage (anchor's seven 2-byte quoted `\`-sharers,
`zero_width`/`class_zero_width` `\Q`/`\E` markers, `property_escape` `"p{"`/`"P{"`,
`unicode_escape` `"u{"`, `octal_escape` `"o{"`, `atomic_group` `"(?>"`); the
1-byte-terminal+ref shapes lose byte-2 (hex-short `"x"`+payload, `control_escape`
`"c"`+any_char) and fall back to today's byte-1 guard.
**Blast radius:** emit gate unchanged (`top_level && layout_sensitivity().terminals`) ⇒
exactly ONE parser may change at regen: `regex_parser.rs`; the other 10 artifacts must be
byte-identical. Committed Σ617 expected EXACTLY unchanged (guards remove only failing
attempts — the soundness signature); discards drop. Interpreter untouched (the
equivalence gate proves verdict+furthest+AST parity — furthest guaranteed by leg 2).
⛔ HARD CONSTRAINT verbatim (the `.5.i.6` battery): land iff measured faster on fat-LTO
alternated 5×2000 geomean-of-mins both sides rebuilt fresh, + byte-identical ASTs under
the full oracle battery; outcome-counter pins supersede at land, AST pins do not.

`-0070`/#7-era raws: allocator-self ≈38–40% and proportions PRESERVED — the D0+D1 kills
removed VOLUME, not shape ⇒ the alloc bucket remains speculation-driven and keeps
shrinking only with further discard elimination.

**Residual discard census (post-D1 dumps, 999 bench-wide):** `class_zero_width`
**134/134 — ZERO killed by D1** (its `-0071`-recorded 134 unchanged) + `brace_ws` 37
(nullable-unkillable, unchanged) + `class_atom` 54 + `class_literal` 52 +
`class_bracket_token`/`class_range_decodable_atom`/`class_range_endpoint` 75 +
`quant_base`+`quantifier` 90 + digit family ≈90 + `atom` 63 (the `(`-cluster) +
`zero_width` 59 (87 pre-D1 ⇒ 28 killed — only its Or-branch exposure died).
**WHY class_zero_width survived intact (the finding):** its entries come from
`class_range = class_atom class_zero_width* "-" class_zero_width* class_atom` — a
QUANTIFIED element inside a SEQUENCE, entered once per class character; every landed
guard (`.5.c.2`, P2, D1) fires ONLY at rule-top-level Or branch dispatch, so the rule is
entered, its internal (guarded) branches fail fast, and the ENTRY frame itself is the
discarded cost. Same class: the class-range endpoint family, `brace_ws`-adjacent probes,
digit probes under `quant_bound`-style optionals.

**Q-GUARD — the named next increment (soundness-designed here, STEP-0 to price):**
FIRST-guarded ATTEMPT ELISION at min-0 quantified (`X*`, `X?`, `{,M}`) sites — when
`next_byte ∉ FIRST(X)` (X non-nullable + resolved + trust-gated), skip X's attempt
entirely and emit the EXACT furthest emulation `if p > furthest { furthest = p }`.
Soundness: (1) selection — the attempt would fail at byte 1 (the `.5.c.2` argument), the
quantifier takes its zero-iteration path either way; (2) furthest-parity — UNLIKE the D1
Or-branch case (emulation REJECTED there because an earlier in-branch alternative can die
before reaching the entry), a min-0 quantifier ALWAYS attempts its element exactly once
at p, and a byte-1-refuted attempt performs every rule entry AT p (the D1 lemma at offset
0) ⇒ the emulation is EXACT, not an over-approximation. License mirrors the P2 (e) gate
conservatively (exclude elements whose rule carries branch-start effects/pre-predicates —
rolled back on failure anyway, but counters/diagnostics stay honest by exclusion).
**Extrapolated surface:** ≈250–400 of the 999 residual discards (the quantified-site
families above) ⇒ **≈−7–15% min-basis** at the D0/D1 exchange rate — recorded as
EXTRAPOLATION; the STEP-0 census lane (enumerate min-0 sites + FIRST-resolvability +
measured entry exposure) prices it honestly before emission. This also names
character_class's 1.018 best-min: its 455 residual discards are EXACTLY this class —
D1 added guard checks there while killing almost nothing; Q-guard targets its surface.

**Adjudication:** D1-ii (byte-3 dispatch for the `(`-cluster) re-priced on the residual —
`atom` 63 discards ⇒ ≈−1.5–2% — THIN, parked behind Q-guard. D2 cascade folding stays
parked (rule frames P1-harvested; census entry share ≈1.04× unchanged). D3
memo-necessity stays parked (memo self 0.2–0.3%). **ROAD: Q-GUARD STEP-0 (census lane +
pricing) → Q-GUARD emission under the ⛔ battery → re-profile.**

#### `.5.i.7` Q-GUARD STEP-0 — THE QUANT-SITE CENSUS LANE (session #120, 2026-07-14, `PGEN-RGX-0078-0076`): enumerate min-0 quantified/optional sites + FIRST-resolvability + measured entry exposure — pricing the `-0075` extrapolation (≈−7–15%) honestly BEFORE emission

**Design (recorded before code — the D1 STEP-0 precedent):** a new census lane in
`fusibility_census.rs` mirroring the choice-site pattern:
- **Site enumeration** — every `ASTNode::Quantified` node in every rule body, pre-order
  (`q#N` per rule; nested sites censused independently — emission guards each
  `generate_quantified_logic` loop locally, so unlike Or-branch guards there is NO
  rule-top-level R1 restriction: whenever execution reaches the quantifier at `p`, a
  min-0 site attempts its element exactly once AT `p` — the `-0075` exactness lemma).
- **Guardability gates (named blockers, deterministic order):** (1) `min == 0`
  (`parse_quantifier_bounds` — `*`/`?`/`{,M}`/`{0,M}`; min>0 sites listed for steering,
  blocked for this lane); (2) terminal-layout trust `layout.terminals` (the P2 R2
  mirror — the next-byte peek is `input[p]` only without an implicit leading skip);
  (3) element first-byte-decided via the SHARED predicate
  `first_set::branch_dispatch_first_bytes(element)` (non-nullable + resolved +
  regex-token layout-trust + every FIRST terminal byte-extractable — the same
  no-census-vs-emission-drift discipline as P2/D1; nullable elision is structurally
  meaningless anyway: a nullable element's zero-length success commits effects the
  skip would drop); (4) the `-0075` P2-(e) mirror — NO rule reachable (transitive
  reference closure, over-approximating the attempt's descent surface) from the
  element subtree carries Branch-phase predicates or branch-start effect directives
  (rolled back on failure anyway; excluded so counters/diagnostics stay honest).
- **Exposure join (outcome dumps):** per-rule aggregate counters cannot split a rule
  referenced from several sites (`class_zero_width` appears under TWO `class_range`
  quantified sites — per-site sole-attribution misses it by construction), so the lane
  attributes at POPULATION level: a rule is **Q-attributable** iff EVERY grammar-wide
  reference occurrence sits inside a GUARDABLE min-0 site's element subtree (its
  measured raw/committed/discarded sums count once); rules under ≥1 guardable site but
  also referenced elsewhere are the **shared-exposure** lane (upper-bound context,
  never priced). Honest bound stated up front: attributable DISCARDED is an
  over-approximation of the kill — a byte-1-ADMITTED, byte-2+-refuted attempt survives
  the guard (the D1 residual lesson); the priced ceiling carries this caveat.
- **Report:** `QUANT-SITE-CENSUS:` + gate line + guardable-site list + blocker
  histogram + `QUANT-EXPOSURE:` (attributable/shared sums + top attributable rules);
  JSON via the existing `--fusibility-census-json` serialization; unit tests for the
  verdicts + the attribution join.

**Protocol:** implement lane → rebuild `ast_pipeline` → regenerate the 8-pattern
outcome dumps with the debug `parseability_probe` (sums must reproduce the `-0074`
pins 1616/617/999/183 byte-exactly — dump-freshness tripwire) → run the census with
the joined dumps → transcribe + price at the D0/D1 exchange rate vs the ≈−7–15%
extrapolation → adjudicate GO/NO-GO for Q-GUARD emission.

#### `.5.i.7` Q-GUARD EMISSION DESIGN (session #120, 2026-07-14 — recorded BEFORE emission; slice `PGEN-RGX-0078-0077`)

**The emission form:** FIRST-guarded ATTEMPT ELISION at min-0 quantified sites, local to
each site's emitted code — NO top-level restriction (the R1 argument is replaced by the
EXACT furthest emulation). TWO emission sites exist (discovered reading the generator —
the census's single `Quantified` node maps to two codegen paths):
1. `generate_quantified_logic` (the unified (min,max) loop — `*`, `{,M}`, and `?` when
   not a direct sequence element): guard inserted in the loop AFTER the safety/boundary/
   max checks, immediately BEFORE the per-iteration `try_parse` —
   `if pos >= len || !matches!(input[pos], F₁…) { «emulation» break; }`. Fires at EVERY
   iteration boundary (iteration 0 = the elided sole attempt; iteration k>0 = the elided
   loop-EXIT attempt — both byte-1-refuted counterfactuals).
2. `generate_sequence_element`'s `?` fast-path arm (optional element mid-sequence,
   bypasses the loop): guard wraps the `try_parse`; the else-arm emits «emulation» +
   the same `ParseContent::Sequence(Vec::new())` the failed attempt returns today.

**License (= the census gates, shared predicates — no drift):** min==0 +
`layout_sensitivity().terminals` (the R2 peek gate, same as `emit_first_set_guard`) +
`first_set::branch_dispatch_first_bytes(element)` Ok (the SHARED P2/D1/census predicate)
+ the gate-4 mirror (census `reachable_rules` × the P2 emission helpers
`rule_has_branch_phase_predicates`/`rule_has_branch_start_effects` — the same compiled
table) + a NEW shared frontier classification `first_set::quantified_element_frontier`:
- **BareRef** (the element, unwrapping group shells, is exactly a rule/builtin
  reference — the dominant population incl. both `class_zero_width*` sites): guard +
  emulation `if pos > furthest { furthest = pos }`. EXACT: a refuted attempt ALWAYS
  executes the referenced rule/builtin/inlined frame's entry preamble at p (the `-0075`
  lemma; deeper same-position entries are idempotent under max). The MEMO-HIT case is
  exact by MONOTONICITY: a fail-set hit at p implies an earlier REAL attempt at p
  already bumped furthest ≥ p, so both the counterfactual hit (no preamble) and the
  emulation no-op — the emulation can never over-advance.
- **NoRefs** (element subtree contains NO rule references — pure terminal/regex
  probing): guard WITHOUT emulation. EXACT: only rule methods / native builtins /
  inlined frames write `furthest_position`; a refuted terminal attempt writes nothing.
- **Mixed** (anything else): UNGUARDED this increment — whether a refuted attempt
  enters a rule at p depends on inner Or/optional structure; a wrong guess either
  over-advances (the D1-rejected class) or loses diagnostics. Census-recorded for a
  possible v2 frontier fold.

**Observable deltas (the D0/D1 precedent, documented not hidden):** raw/discard entry
counters drop truthfully (pins supersede; committed **Σ617 must stay EXACTLY
unchanged** — the hard tripwire); skipped attempts emit no trace lines (guard-skip
class, same as `.5.c.2`/D1); skipped attempts no longer INSERT cached failures into the
memo (absence is correct — a later unguarded query re-executes and re-derives the same
failure; the 183 memo-hit pin may supersede truthfully); `furthest_position` parity
EXACT by the frontier rule (the interpreter stays UNTOUCHED — the differential gates
are the enforcement).

**Battery (⛔ HARD CONSTRAINT):** regen audit — ONLY `regex_parser.rs` may change (regex
is the sole terminals-ws-sensitive grammar; all 10 others byte-identical); AST dumps
8/8 byte-identical vs the `-0070` refs; committed Σ617 exact; cert 0/7/42
`267/9/258/0` + spf `0/1/1` byte-exact; dual-feature lib incl. the 3 interpreter
differential gates; ast-shape / PCRE2 compile-oracle / clippy-source / mdbook; bench =
alternated 5×2000 vs the preserved D1 canonical probe (`6134ebc0…`, sha-verified before
use), fat-LTO builds under the memory guard. Expected: ≈−6–12% min-basis (the `-0076`
priced ceiling), kill anchor `class_zero_width` 134.

tournament checkpoint/delta/rollback, per-level arena node + shaped-value copy). The census

expressive than a DFA:

  no lexical follow restriction) + policy-encodable (no `nonassoc`, no `@deterministic_group`)
  + no `@profiles`/`@transform`/value-constraints. THAT IS ALL.

  skips ALLOWED** (fused code skips inline). **Lookahead ALLOWED** (position-reset probes are
  cheap in an effect-free region). **Every `UnifiedReturnAST` variant is a static
  constructor/selector** (PositionalRef/literals/Object/Array/Spread/FlattenSpread/
  PropertyAccess/ArrayAccess/QuantifiedExtraction/Passthrough/MatchedText — enumerated, no
  dynamic form exists) ⇒ the value side blocks ONLY on `@transform`+constraints.
- **Regions root at protocol boundaries** (eligible ∧ (entry ∨ referenced-by-ineligible ∨
  unreferenced) — the EntryShare maximal-root logic under the D2 gate; a rule referenced from
  both sides classes as a ROOT, so inside-region entries on it are conservatively NOT counted
  as kills). References eligible→ineligible = **boundary call-outs** (fused code calls the
  ordinary method; named per rule).

**Tripwire + fact base (fresh, this session; scratchpad `d2spike/`):** parser `ff072136…` ✓;
fresh 8-pattern outcome dumps from the debug probe — totals **1331/617/714/180 byte-exact**;
census re-run reproduces `-0084` exactly (`CASCADE-CENSUS 234/274 (20/214/28) residual=40
boundary_edges=32`; `CASCADE-EXPOSURE internal=979 (73.6%) committed=518 discarded=462
memo_hits=125 | roots=210/85 | residual=142/14 | committed_floor=99`). NEW measured facts this
design consumed (dump-join + the gen-AST reference graph, recomposition cross-checked
541+188+250=979):
- **The 125 internal memo hits sit on exactly 3 rules:** `atom` **61 (CYCLIC — the ⛔
  session-#49 class)**, `class_literal` 57 (acyclic leaf), `class_safe_special` 7 (acyclic
  leaf). The boundedness obligation is therefore concentrated and nameable per class.
- **Acyclic/cyclic partition of the internal exposure** (cyclic rules treated as protocol
  boundaries): acyclic sub-regions = **56 sub-roots + 149 internal rules, 541 internal
  entries (40.6%**; per-pattern 16.0–72.9%, `character_class` 72.9% = the anchor); the cyclic
  extension = 250 cyclic-internal entries (atom 122, piece 80, concat/alt 18, groups 12…) +
  188 sub-root entries PROMOTED to internal when their cyclic callers fold
  (zero_width 59, literal 34, quantifier 22, anchor 20, escape 18…).
- **`furthest_position` is updated at RULE ENTRY ONLY** (275 sites = one per method) ⇒ exact
  emulation is a single max-update at every internal-call head, by construction.
- **`try_parse` snapshots position + coverage + parse-stack + the SEMANTIC CHECKPOINT** ⇒ the
  fused speculation license (plain position-restore) holds ONLY where no boundary call-out is
  reachable inside the speculation scope (see C3-B rules below).

**THE EMISSION FORM (decisions, with the WHY):**
1. **OBSERVABILITY-TWIN DISPATCH at region-root memoized bodies.** Each region root's method
   keeps its FULL protocol frame (guard/counter/coverage/furthest/trace/transaction/memo — the
   census committed-floor model); inside its `memoized_call` body: `if self.bare_parse {
   return self.cascade_<root>(); }` else the protocol body VERBATIM. `bare_parse` = a bool
   cached at parse start: no coverage, no trace, no counters/memo-stats consumer requested
   (every diagnostic surface — cert-coverage, `--dump-rule-*-counts-json`, the dashboard,
   `--trace-rules`, `PGEN_REPORT_MEMO_STATS` — sets its flag ⇒ protocol graph). WHY: every
   observability consumer gets EXACT machinery (witness records, counters, trace — not
   "equivalent" ones), the outcome pins **1331/617/714/180 stay byte-exact FOREVER** (no
   documented-delta protocol at all — a battery simplification vs D0/D1/Q), and the fused
   graph stays clean of interleaved flag branches. Entry-relative parses (`--entry-rule`)
   call methods ⇒ protocol graph, unchanged. The protocol graph must stay CLOSED (protocol
   bodies call methods, never fused fns).
2. **The fused graph:** one compact `cascade_<rule>` fn per region-internal rule (recursive
   for cyclic rules, D2-B). Byte/FIRST₂ dispatch lowered from the SHARED `first_set` facts
   (`branch_dispatch_first_bytes`/`quantified_element_frontier`) — subsumes the landed
   D1/Q guards natively inside regions under the SAME furthest-parity licenses (the guards
   remain in the protocol twin verbatim). Speculation = plain `saved_pos` restore (the
   effect-free license). **Furthest max-update emitted at every internal-call head** = exact
   by the rule-entry-only fact. Boundary call-outs = the ordinary `parse_<X>` methods.
   Memo-hit replay differences cannot surface: furthest is a max already reached on first
   execution at the same position (effect-free determinism).
3. **C3-B / store soundness rules (the two ⛔ rules any emission MUST encode):**
   - a fused speculation scope that can reach a **boundary call-out** (statically known
     per site from the census graph) carries the semantic-checkpoint snapshot/rollback —
     the [[feedback_try_parse_must_snapshot_semantic_state]] doctrine at fused granularity;
   - an Or site with ≥1 boundary-reaching branch keeps the **protocol tournament as a site
     ISLAND** (C3-B losing-successful-branch persistence is store-visible). Island-vs-demotion
     PRICED: demoting the 18 acyclic boundary-carrying rules to call-outs strands their
     subtrees — D2-A exposure collapses 541 → 320 entries (−18–25% → −11–15%) ⇒ **islands
     mandated**, per-site refinement owned by the emission slice.
4. **Value side: EAGER-BUILD first.** Fused fns return the rule's post-transform
   `ParseContent` directly — the STATIC final shape per rule (every `UnifiedReturnAST`
   variant is a static constructor): no per-level `Alternative` wrapper, no `raw_content
   .clone()`, no transform re-walk. Build-eagerly mirrors today's value timing ⇒
   byte-identity is structurally easy. **MATCH-THEN-BUILD recorded as the v2 lever** against
   the RE-PROFILE-#9 ≈40% speculation-shaped allocator bucket (build only on the committed
   walk) — a separate falsifiable increment, NOT in D2-A/B scope.
5. **The thin memo (D2-B only) — the ⛔ #49 bound honored by construction:**
   cycle-participating fused rules NEVER lose memo protection. Region thin memo =
   `(rule_local_id, pos) → {end_pos, value, write_epoch_stamp}` in a flat per-parse map; NO
   fail-set/taint cascade, but the **write-epoch stamp IS validated at replay** (evict on
   mismatch + re-execute) — REQUIRED because a cyclic rule's subtree can reach fact-writing
   boundary call-outs (`atom → python_named_backreference`, `capturing_group →
   capture_open`), so unstamped replay could skip a store state-change: the
   MEMO-STORE-SOUNDNESS.2 semantics carried over. Acyclic fused rules drop memo entirely —
   **boundedness proof:** with no cycles, same-position re-probe multiplicity is bounded by
   the static caller-multiplicity constant of the grammar ⇒ total re-execution is linear in
   input, no super-linear class exists; the measured D2-A lost-hit surface is 64 hits on two
   LEAF bodies (`class_literal` 57 / `class_safe_special` 7 — byte-check bodies cheaper to
   re-run than today's probe+replay-clone). Cyclic re-probes (the 61 `atom` hits) replay
   from the thin memo ⇒ packrat asymptotics preserved.
6. **Census→emission single implementation** (the P1a `compute_inline_decisions` precedent +
   the [[census-emission single-implementation]] lesson): a `build_cascade_emission_plan` in
   `ast_based_generator.rs` consuming the SHARED `fusibility_census` cascade verdicts (same
   gate, same partition — report and emitted parser cannot drift). Parser-agnostic per
   [[feedback_features_parser_agnostic_enable_all_parsers]] (vhdl = ONE 216-rule region is
   the platform prize; regex is the campaign target).
7. **Cost watch:** the fused graph is a SECOND code graph for the region (compact — no
   protocol boilerplate/trace strings — but real): compile-time/code-size measured at the
   D2-A land gate against the fat-LTO 8–13 min baseline; the P1a expansion-budget discipline
   available if needed.

line + `[cascade-plan]` DUMP_ALL verdicts + the additive `cascade_plan` JSON field), so
report and emission cannot drift. 3 unit tests (partition under cyclic callers /
effect-reaching transitivity through non-fused methods / entry+unreferenced sub-roots +
census-carries-the-same-plan).

**Emission (per the `-0085` design §5 + the `-0089` STEP-2 obligations, with the
measured thin-memo refinement and one protection-relocation refinement recorded
below):**
- `build_cascade_emission_plan_for_codegen` consumes the SHARED plan at
  `CascadeIncrement::CyclicSpine` (the `-0089` seam): every cascade-eligible rule fused —
  regex 20 sub-roots / 214 internal / 29 thin_memo = the census's own full-fold split.
  `CascadeCodegenPlan` gains `thin_memo_internal` (= thin_memo ∩ internal).
- **Twin-dispatch RELOCATION as obligated:** the 20 B sub-roots keep protocol frame +
  twin dispatch; the 37 former A sub-roots demote to plain fused internals (methods
  remain for the protocol graph; fused references become direct `cascade_*` calls).
  Measured on the artifact: dispatch sites 195 → 108, dispatch returns 61 → 35, fused
  fns 205 → 234 (`d8173f31…` → **`8c26c97f…`**, 39.9 → 40.4MB).
- **The THIN MEMO (`ThinMemoEntry`, engine-owned in `mod.rs`):** every INTERNAL
  thin_memo rule's fused fn probes/inserts `(rule, pos) → {stamp, outcome}` around a
  closure-wrapped body (the `?`-cleanup IIFE doctrine). Entries carry the protocol
  memo's OWN taint classes, measured across the body by three engine counters (write
  epoch / deferred-obligation count / predicate-evaluation counter): **PURE** (no read,
  no mutation) → replay at ANY store state (the protocol's untainted license — value-only
  replay skips nothing because the body wrote nothing); **STORE-READ** → replay iff
  epoch + deferred count unchanged since (MEMO-STORE-SOUNDNESS.2; ⛔ the #49 bound's
  tainted-read class keeps protection); **STORE-MUTATING** → never cached (a value-only
  replay would skip effects the protocol memo re-applies from its stored delta; honest
  deterministic re-execution instead). Failures are cached too (`outcome: None`),
  replayed as `Backtrack` at the probe position — the protocol memo's exact
  failure-replay shape.
- **The recursion-guard frame for cyclic INTERNAL fused fns:** `check_cycle` +
  `enter`/`exit` mirrored from the protocol method (reject arms identical minus trace
  lines — a bare parse can never enable trace). WHY load-bearing: the
  `Infinite`/`LeftRecursive` verdicts scan the parse stack for THIS rule's in-flight
  frames — exact iff every cyclic rule pushes in both graphs (the D2-A elision was exact
  only because an acyclic rule can never self-re-enter — the Optim #16 argument). The
  whole-stack depth ceiling keeps the landed D2-A margin semantics (the bare-path stack
  omits acyclic fused frames in both increments; B strictly narrows the gap by restoring
  the cyclic pushes).
- **PROTECTION-RELOCATION refinement vs the `-0089` note (recorded honestly):** a cyclic
  SUB-ROOT (regex: `pattern`) gets NEITHER lane in its cascade fn. The `-0089` note
  anticipated fused bodies entering sub-root cascade fns recursively; the landed emitter
  instead routes EVERY fused reference to a sub-root through its protocol METHOD (the
  A-emitter invariant kept), so each bare-path entry passes the method's full frame —
  `check_cycle`, the parse-stack push, and the REAL memo (strictly stronger than the
  thin memo; the #49 bound held by a stronger mechanism). A duplicated guard frame
  inside its cascade fn would in fact see the method's own in-flight `(rule, position)`
  frame and falsely report `Infinite` — excluded by construction, pinned by a unit test.
- **Cyclicity drift assert (loud, the P1a precedent):** the guard-frame license is a
  cyclicity claim resolved by two analyses (census `rule_reaches_itself` behind
  `thin_memo`; generator `compute_recursive_rules` behind the protocol `check_cycle`
  emission). `generate_cascade_impl` bails on any fused rule where they disagree — held
  across all 11 regens.
- 3 new emitter unit tests (cascade module 6 total): cyclic-internal guard+thin-memo
  emission with recursive direct cascade calls + the acyclic frame-free shape preserved;
  cyclic sub-root = twin dispatch + method-routed self-reference + NO guard/thin lane +
  `cascade_thin_memo_active()==false` when the thin set is sub-root-only; former-A
  sub-root demotion (internal verdict + direct cascade references + twin dispatch

#### `.5.i.7` MTB v2 STEP-0 — THE `f_spec` ALLOC-CENSUS INSTRUMENT (session #127, 2026-07-15, `PGEN-RGX-0078-0092`): `regex_alloc_census_probe` LANDED + MEASURED — **f_spec floor 80.7–93.4% per pattern (allocs; aggregate 90.9%), ≈95–97% by bytes**; 26.6–42.3% of in-metric allocs freed BEFORE the stopwatch; the instrument reconciles EXACTLY (`in_alloc − in_free == td_free`, teardown allocs = 0) ⇒ **MTB v2 re-priced −57→−68% → ≈4.5–6.0µs; GO to the design spike**

**WHAT (the instrument, a new tracked bin — `rust/src/bin/regex_alloc_census_probe.rs`;
the canonical `regex_perf_probe` timing instrument deliberately UNTOUCHED):** a
counting `GlobalAlloc` wrapper (System-backed; alloc/alloc_zeroed/realloc/dealloc all
counted, realloc = alloc(new)+free(old) so totals balance) around the SAME parse the
perf probe times, segmented at EXACTLY the stopwatch boundaries:
- **IN-METRIC** = arena + parser construction + `parse_full_regex()` (bare ⇒ the FUSED
  graph — no diagnostic consumer touched, the MTB target population itself);
- **TEARDOWN** = dropping result/parser/arena after the `elapsed()` point (the arena
  mass free — traffic the min metric NEVER sees, reported separately so no ceiling is
  priced on it — the P4-ii/P4-iii lesson mechanized);
- **COMMITTED proxy** = counted `serde_json::to_value(&parsed)` over a fresh parse — a
  fresh copy of every committed value node. Honest proxy bounds NAMED both directions:
  over-counts committed borrows (`Terminal` = zero-alloc in-parse, a `String` in the
  copy) ⇒ the derived `f_spec` is a FLOOR; under-counts committed intermediate copies
  (winner-replay clones MTB would also kill) ⇒ true kill ≥ the floor.
Warmup pass over all patterns before measurement (lazy global state paid up front);
`--repeat N` (default 2) asserts counts identical across repeats.

#### `.5.i.7` MTB v2 EMISSION DESIGN (session #128, 2026-07-15, `PGEN-RGX-0078-0093` — recorded BEFORE any emission code, the D0/D1/Q/D2 discipline): the DERIVATION-TAPE two-pass form — match fns record the committed derivation, build fns construct values ONCE over it; the ISLAND obligation REFINED AWAY (island losers stop building values too); increments MTB-A (acyclic sub-regions, measured 84.1% of fused doomed entries, ceiling ≈−40–47%) → MTB-B (cyclic spine + segment thin memo, toward the full −57→−68% band)

**Tripwire + fact base (fresh, this session; scratchpad `mtb_design/`):** 16/16 dumps
(8 outcome + 8 AST) regenerated from the current debug probe `cmp`-byte-exact vs the
`-0091`/`-0092` refs; pins **1331/617/714/180 byte-exact** (recomputed from the fresh
dumps). NEW measured/verified facts this design consumed:
- **Doomed-entry topology (dump-join vs the census plan lists, `census_r1.json`):**
  discarded entries on FUSED rules = **586/714 (82.1%)** of all bench discards; of
  those, the acyclic plan-A population (A-internal 149 + A-sub-roots 56) carries
  **493/586 (84.1%)** — `character_class` (the top alloc pattern, f_spec 92.9%) is
  274/295 fused and 268/274 A-covered. Non-fused (boundary/residual) discards = 128,
  concentrated on the alloc-light leaf rules (`digit`/`letter`/`nonzero_digit` —
  `Terminal` content, zero-alloc values).
- **The heavy retained class is measured EMPTY on the bench:** the `pattern` sub-root
  (the only non-leaf sub-root whose orchestrator-grain value could be built-then-
  discarded by an enclosing loser) has **raw=6 committed=6 discarded=0** across all 8
  patterns — sub-root-grain doomed values sit only on the cheap leaves.
- **Terminal-event surface (artifact facts, `generated/regex_parser.rs` at
  `8c26c97f…`):** the regex artifact contains **ZERO `match_regex` calls** (every
  terminal is a static `match_string` literal or an engine builtin method) and regex
  is layout-INSENSITIVE (`if false { consume_layout_for_terminal }`), with
  `match_string` post-position == token end == start + static literal length ⇒ for
  regex the derivation tape needs **no terminal events at all** — token spans and the
  position cursor are fully derivable at build time. (`match_regex`-bearing grammars
  record one `TokEnd` per dynamic-length terminal; layout-skipping grammars one
  `TokStart` per literal — both statically elided where derivable.)
- **The fused value-build surface (artifact census):** 234 `cascade_*` fns; 138
  `ParseContent::Json` construction sites; **27 C3-B tournament islands on 26 fused
  rules**; **259 boundary method call-out sites** (dominated by `parse_digit` 121 +
  the leaf sub-roots — cheap `Terminal` values; `parse_pattern` 13 = the one heavy
  target, measured discard-free above).
- **Transforms are pure over `content` + spans** (verified on the emitted
  `cascade_capturing_group` shaped transform: serde `Map` construction +
  `to_json_value()` over the structural `ParseContent` — no parser-state mutation),
  so deferring them to a build pass is license-free inside the fused graph.

**THE EMISSION FORM (decisions, with the WHY):**
1. **THE DERIVATION TAPE, not winner-re-run.** One parser-owned
   `deriv_events: Vec<DerivEvent>` + one `deriv_boundary: Vec<&'input ParseNode>`
   (engine types in `mod.rs`; struct fields emitted per-artifact, plan-gated like
   `thin_memo`). Match fns append events; EVERY speculation-failure restore point
   also truncates both vecs to its saved marks (the tape is position-like state; the
   truncation lives in the CALLER's failure arm, never inside the `try_parse` closure
   — the [[feedback_question_bypasses_manual_cleanup]] rule applied to the tape).
   The build pass walks the committed tape once, constructing the exact
   `ParseContent`/`ParseNode` values bottom-up with a REPLAYED position cursor.
   WHY not "re-run the winner in build mode": a committed node at `Or`-nesting depth
   k would be re-matched k+1 times (the regex spine is exactly such a nest) — the
   tape form does strictly less work and needs no re-matching at all.
2. **Event vocabulary (measured-minimal):** `OrWinner(branch_idx)` at multi-branch
   non-P2 `Or` sites (P2 byte-switch sites need NO event — the build pass
   re-dispatches on the input byte at the replayed cursor, deterministic by
   construction); `QuantCount(n)` at quantified sites (placeholder pushed at loop
   entry, patched at loop exit — enclosing-failure truncation keeps it consistent);
   `OptPresent(0|1)` at `?` sites (mandatory: a static-literal inner produces zero
   events yet advances the cursor); `Boundary` (implicit side-vec order) at value-
   producing call-outs; `TokEnd`/`TokStart` only where dynamic (zero sites in regex).
   Everything else — element spans, rule spans, `Terminal` borrows — derives from
   cursor replay (element_start = cursor; element_end = child-derived; verified
   `match_string` semantics above). Tournament winner-segment handling is IN-TAPE
   COMPACTION: a candidate's events append after the current best segment; on
   `should_take` the candidate region memmoves down over the best, else truncate —
   one vec, POD moves, zero extra allocation.
3. **Two fn families replace the eager fn for MTB-population rules:**
   `match_<rule>` = today's `cascade_<rule>` control flow VERBATIM (guards, FIRST/
   FIRST₂/Q-prune licenses, furthest head max-update, speculation classes, store
   machinery) minus ALL value construction — no `sequence_elements` vec, no arena
   writes, no transforms; appends events. `build_<rule>` = the value half only:
   consumes the tape cursor, no matching, no guards, constructs the exact structural
   `ParseContent` + the rule/branch transforms (debug-assert: the built winner's end
   == the recorded `best_end` — the drift tripwire). Sub-root `cascade_<rule>` fns
   become ORCHESTRATORS: mark → `match_<rule>` → on success `build_<rule>` over
   `[mark..]` → truncate to mark → return the `ParseNode` — SIGNATURE UNCHANGED, so
   the twin dispatch and every method-call seam are untouched, and orchestrator
   nesting (a sub-root method called mid-match) is a clean stack discipline on the
   single tape. WHY two static families: token volume ≈ today's interleaved fn split
   in two (the match half loses the value code, the build half is value-only), and
   the mode test is compile-time — no runtime mode branches on the hot path.
4. **🔎 THE ISLAND OBLIGATION REFINED AWAY (loudly — a design improvement over the
   `-0092` recorded obligation, surfaced):** C3-B islands keep checkpoint / per-
   branch `try_parse` / delta extraction / rollback / winner-delta replay VERBATIM —
   but lose per-branch VALUE building: the `should_take` chain needs only
   (end, priority, index), and the winner's value is its tape segment, built on the
   committed walk like every other site. Island LOSERS stop building values too —
   strictly better than the recorded "eager-build islands at `effect_targets`".
   LICENSE: a fused rule carries no runtime directives (the cascade gate), so no
   fused value is ever consulted mid-parse; the plan partition guarantees ineligible
   rules reference only fused SUB-ROOTS (whose methods return orchestrator-built full
   values) — the only mid-parse value consumers are protocol methods, which sit at
   boundaries by construction. `effect_targets` keeps exactly its D2 role (
   `try_parse` vs plain-restore; island vs plain tournament) and no longer gates
   value eagerness.
5. **Boundary call-outs stay eager by construction:** protocol methods (ineligible
   rules, sub-root methods, engine builtins) return values as today → pushed to
   `deriv_boundary` + one `Boundary` event; the build pass splices them in order;
   truncated with the tape on failure. In MTB-A only, a match fn's reference to a
   still-eager CYCLIC fused fn is handled the same way (dissolves into a match call
   in MTB-B).
6. **Thin memo × MTB — memoize the derivation record, not values (⛔ the #49 bound
   honored):** cyclic internal match fns keep the protocol-mirror guard frame + the
   epoch-stamped thin memo with the SAME taint classes (PURE / STORE-READ /
   STORE-MUTATING) and validation; the entry payload becomes
   `(end_pos, event-segment copy, boundary-ref-segment copy)` — a hit replays by
   appending both segments + setting the position. SOUND because cached bodies are
   non-mutating by the taint classes (replaying recorded boundary VALUES skips no
   store effect) and STORE-READ stamps validate exactly as today. Cost: POD segment
   memcpy per insert/hit vs today's shallow node clone — priced small (180 bench memo
   hits; regex segments are structure-only events).
7. **⛔ The core-type trap named up front (the `-0090` lesson):** changing
   `ThinMemoEntry`'s payload is the EMITTED-type bootstrap-drift class ⇒ additive
   transient migration (introduce the segment-payload type alongside; regen all 11
   canonically; retire the old shape only after every artifact is at the new
   codegen) — NEVER a bootstrap-binary regen (the `null→"null"` trap).
8. **Cost watch:** fn count ≈×2 for MTB-population rules (regex 234 → ≈449 incl.
   orchestrators; SV 1046 → ≈2000 at MTB-B) at roughly today's total token volume;
   compile RAM measured under the recalibrated 16384MB guard at each land gate;
   SAFETY VALVE = per-rule eager fallback (any rule may keep the interleaved
   match+build form with every seam intact — a sound local fallback, the P1a
   budget-decision precedent) if compile cost breaches.
9. **Observability twin unchanged (obligation 5 verbatim):** the protocol graph keeps
   eager builds and every diagnostic consumer flag-routes to it ⇒ outcome pins
   1331/617/714/180 + cert witnesses + trace byte-exact forever; the equivalence /
   combinator / semantic gates and the PCRE2 corpus run BARE parses ⇒ they exercise
   the MTB graph directly (the strongest byte-identity oracle, as for D2).

**INCREMENT SLICING + FALSIFIABLE CEILINGS (bases named; basis 13.98µs, the #11
70.9% value/alloc time complex × the `-0092` measured f_spec, scaled by the measured
population splits above; ⚠️ entry-share proxies for the A/B split — the P4-iii
SAMPLED-SHARE caveat named, the emission gate stays land-iff-faster on the min
metric):**
- **MTB-1 / MTB-A — ENGINE TAPE TYPES + THE ACYCLIC SUB-REGION PASS:** re-use the
  `CascadeIncrement::AcyclicSubRegions` plan (already computed for the census lanes):
  the 149 A-internal fns become match/build pairs, the 56 A-sub-root cascade fns
  become orchestrators, the cyclic spine fns stay VERBATIM (their existing
  `cascade_<A-sub-root>()` calls hit orchestrators at an unchanged signature; the
  plan partition proves cyclic fns never reference A-INTERNAL rules directly).
  Measured population: 84.1% of fused doomed entries (82.1% of all), the
  `character_class` anchor 91%+ covered, `pattern`-grain retained doom measured ZERO.
  Ceiling bands (attackable = 70.9% × f_spec × 0.821 × 0.841): conservative
  (worst-pattern f=0.807) **−39.6% → 8.44µs**; aggregate-events (f=0.909) **−44.6%
  → 7.75µs**; bytes-basis (f=0.956) **−46.9% → 7.42µs** ⇒ **≈7.4–8.4µs from
  13.98µs**. Retained classes named: successful-but-rolled-back orchestrator-grain
  values (leaf-concentrated, alloc-light), non-fused boundary doom, tape machinery.
- **MTB-B — THE CYCLIC-SPINE PASS + SEGMENT THIN MEMO:** spine fns → match/build
  pairs (the remaining ≈16% of fused doomed entries + the committed-path tournament
  losers on the spine), B-sub-root orchestrators, A-orchestrators demote to plain
  pairs, thin-memo entries carry segments (form 6). Ceiling: toward the full
  `-0092` f_spec band **−57→−68% → ≈4.5–6.0µs**; ⛔ RE-PRICED after MTB-A on a fresh
  census + profile (#12) — the stale-cost-basis lesson, never emit on a stale model.
- **Emission order: MTB-A → re-census + re-profile #12 → MTB-B → re-profile #13 →
  the bar-program re-adjudication (D2-C re-price on the post-MTB basis + the
  committed-value REPRESENTATION increment the `-0091` bar-sharpening names).**

**OBLIGATION DISCHARGE MAP (vs the `-0092` recorded obligations):** (1) two-pass form
= the tape design (form 1–3); (2) eager-build islands = REFINED AWAY with the license
named (form 4 — better than recorded, surfaced); (3) C3-B losers lengths-only =
exact: losers contribute (end, priority, index) + a truncated segment, values never
built; (4) thin-memo × MTB = segment payload under the unchanged taint/epoch
machinery (form 6, ⛔ #49 held); (5) twin unchanged (form 9); (6) the `.5.i.6`
battery verbatim + land-iff-faster at the min metric for EVERY increment (fat-LTO
alternated 5×2000 geomean-of-mins; 8/8 AST dumps byte-identical; equivalence /
combinator / semantic gates; regex cert seeds 0/7/42 + spf; ast-shape; duality-hunt;
PCRE2 compile-oracle real-tuple; clippy source-strict; all-11 regen + dual-feature
`ast_pipeline` rebuild before the lib suite; outcome pins byte-exact via the twin).

#### `.5.i.7` MTB-A EMISSION — ATTEMPTED + REFUTED-AS-STANDALONE (session #129, 2026-07-15, `PGEN-RGX-0078-0094`, docs-only after revert): the derivation-tape two-pass emitter at the ACYCLIC increment was written, unit-tested, regenerated across all 11 grammars, and BENCHED — measured **−0.9% (14002.6ns → 13882.0ns, rounds straddling 1.0)** ≪ the −39.6/−44.6/−46.9% ceiling ⇒ **land-iff-faster FAILS; reverted.** 🔎 ROOT CAUSE (tools-first): the ceiling was priced by DISCARDED-ENTRY share (0.841) but the acyclic population is CHEAP LEAVES holding ~2% of ALLOCATIONS; the allocation-heavy doomed traffic (Sequence `Vec`s) is in the CYCLIC SPINE, which MTB-A leaves eager. The win, if any, is entirely in MTB-B (spine fold) — but its ceiling is now UNPROVEN (alloc-share ≠ time-share) and it needs the risky `ThinMemoEntry` core-type migration ⇒ **SURFACED to the director; PNT PAUSED on the MTB-B investment.**

**What was built + measured (the emitter is CORRECT — the finding is about the CEILING, not the code):**
- The full `-0093` MTB-A emitter landed on-branch (engine `DerivEvent` POD enum; `cascade.rs` match/build/orchestrator families + the A/B partition-drift tripwires; plan-gated tape struct fields). 9/9 cascade unit tests GREEN (incl. 3 new MTB tests: match strips values / island keeps delta machinery without values / layout-skipping literals record `TokEnd`).
- All 11 grammars regenerated + compiled clean under `--features generated_parsers`; every artifact carried the MTB split (regex 205 match/build pairs + 224 orchestrator sites, 0 terminal events as designed — layout-sensitive `match_string` spans cursor-derived).
- **Correctness floor INTACT:** the regex tripwire was **16/16 byte-identical** (8 AST via the bare→MTB path + 8 outcome via the twin→protocol path; pins **1331/617/714/180** exact) — the strongest same-vintage proof that the MTB graph's output equals the shipped D2-B graph's. The derivation-tape design is SOUND; it simply does not move the metric.

**The measurement (fat-LTO alternated 5×2000, geomean-of-best-mins, cand `41754e9f` embedding regex `c793e5b1` vs base `0e97d43b` embedding D2-B regex `8c26c97f`):**
- GEOMEAN-OF-MINS **base 14002.6ns → cand 13882.0ns = 0.9914 (−0.9%)**. Per-round ratios **0.979 / 0.984 / 0.986 / 1.003 / 1.009** — STRADDLE 1.0 (rounds 4–5 cand SLOWER) ⇒ noise-level, not a reliable speedup. Per-pattern best-mins: `character_class` −7.7% and `alternation` −5.4% (the alloc-heavy patterns, real); `capture_groups` +2.1% and `digit_sequence` +4.4% (the low-alloc patterns REGRESSED on tape overhead); rest flat.

**🔎 THE DECISIVE DIAGNOSTIC (tools-first, `regex_alloc_census_probe` rebuilt on the MTB artifact `c793e5b1`, ×3 deterministic):**
- MTB in-metric allocs **9518** vs the `-0092` D2-B baseline **9706** = **−1.9%**; f_spec STILL **80.8–93.3%** per pattern. **MTB-A eliminated almost NO allocations.**
- Confirmed the match fns are VALUE-FREE (0 `ParseContent`/`arena.alloc`/`with_capacity` lines) — MTB-A worked exactly as designed. AND confirmed the spine is EAGER (`cascade_pattern`/`cascade_concatenation`/`cascade_atom` present as eager fns, no match/build pair; only leaves `digit`/`letter` got the pair).
- ∴ **the acyclic population MTB-A folds holds 84.1% of discarded ENTRIES but only ~2% of ALLOCATIONS** (cheap leaf `Terminal`s). The allocation-heavy doomed traffic (`Sequence(Vec)`, `Json` transforms) is in the ~16%-of-entries CYCLIC SPINE, left eager by increment A. **The pricing error: DISCARDED-ENTRY share ≠ ALLOCATION/TIME share** — a NEW instance of the P4-iii "sampled-share ≠ min-metric" trap + the per-population-pricing lesson (now for the entry-share-as-alloc-proxy).

**🔎 THE DEEPER OPEN QUESTION surfaced to the director (the reason PNT is PAUSED):** even the IN-METRIC doomed allocs (90% of alloc events by the `-0092` instrument) are proven CHEAP in TIME — eliminating the acyclic 84% moved the metric −0.9%. Whether MTB-B (folding the allocation-heavy spine) recovers real TIME is now UNPROVEN: it depends on whether the spine's `Sequence(Vec)`/`Json` allocs are time-significant or (like the leaves) cheap-in-time. If the latter, the WHOLE match-then-build thesis (value allocation = the dominant in-metric cost) is falsified and the ≤1µs bar needs a different lever (the matching/dispatch COMPUTE, or the committed-value representation the `-0091` bar-sharpening named). MTB-B additionally carries the `-0090` `ThinMemoEntry` core-type bootstrap-drift trap. This is a roadmap-altering, risk-bearing decision ⇒ the director's call per [[feedback_stick_to_agreed_plan_no_silent_drift]] ("unforeseen mid-implementation issue → PAUSE + analyze + AGREE"). Recommendation: RE-PRICE MTB-B on the allocation distribution (spine ≈ 98% of allocs) with a SPINE-ONLY alloc-vs-time micro-probe BEFORE committing to the core-type migration — or pivot the whole `.5` deep-specialization program to the compute/representation lever.

#### `.5.i.7` STEP-0 — ALLOCATOR-BEHAVIOUR MICRO-PROBE (session #130, 2026-07-16, `PGEN-RGX-0078-0097`): part (a) never-free bump-arena CEILING **−40.0%** (the value/alloc lever is REAL on the min metric — resolves the P4-iii sampled-share caveat); part (b) **mimalloc LANDED −29.2%** (deterministic; captures 73% of the (a) ceiling from a one-line allocator swap) ⇒ new tracked closure floor **≈9.77µs ≈51×** with the recommended production allocator

**The two-part instrument (the `-0092` f_spec-instrument precedent — MEASUREMENT-ONLY probe scaffolding, no lib/engine/codegen change; only `rust/src/bin/regex_perf_probe.rs` + a `rust/Cargo.toml` feature line + docs):**
- **(a)** a `never_free_arena_perf` feature adds a RESET-PER-SAMPLE never-free bump `#[global_allocator]` to `regex_perf_probe`: every in-parse `malloc` is a pointer bump and every `free` a no-op, so the RE-PROFILE #11 hypothesis (allocator 41.4/40.8% + `_xzm_free` 21.5/18.5% of self-time) is priced DIRECTLY as a falsifiable min-metric CEILING. Why reset-per-sample (not pure never-free): a bare parse allocates 193KB–438KB in-metric (`regex_alloc_census_probe`) ⇒ ~48–110 FRESH pages/parse; pure never-free would pay ~50–110µs of minor page-fault cost per parse and measure page faults, not allocator cost. The cursor is reset to a mark (taken after warmup, below which the `times` Vec + all lazy statics live) BEFORE each timed sample, OUTSIDE the stopwatch — committed pages stay hot, the timed region sees pure bump-alloc + no-op-free. Correctness guard: `verify_arena_accepts()` asserts all 8 patterns still parse-ACCEPT under the arena; the alternated bench ran 80k+ parses per probe without abort.
- **(b)** the pre-existing `mimalloc_perf` feature (Optim #10 infra) — the bankable candidate; a mature production allocator, correctness-neutral BY CONSTRUCTION (an allocator cannot change program semantics for a program with no allocation-address dependence — the `.4.a` fat-LTO build-profile precedent).

**MEASURED (fat-LTO alternated 5×2000 geomean-of-mins, 3-way base/nfa/mi rebuilt fresh — base `46399285`, nfa `f10d9bfb`, mi `fda39139`; regex artifact UNCHANGED `8c26c97f`; guard peaks 10.5/10.9/10.4GB):**
- **(a) NEVER-FREE CEILING: base 13798.5ns → nfa 8285.3ns = x0.6004 = −40.0%** (geomean-of-best-mins). Per-round ratios **0.6208 / 0.6137 / 0.6045 / 0.5967 / 0.6024** (mean 0.6076) — TIGHT, no straddle, EVERY pattern faster (x0.57–0.64). Independent 3-round confirmation: mean 0.6179 (−38.4%). ⇒ **killing malloc+free buys 40% of the min-metric time — the value/alloc complex is time-real, NOT sampled-share inflation.** The residual 8.29µs (nfa keeps value CONSTRUCTION, drops only the malloc/free syscall) is matching/dispatch + value-construction compute.
- **(b) MIMALLOC: base 13798.5ns → mi 9769.1ns = x0.7080 = −29.2%** (geomean-of-best-mins). Per-round ratios **0.7206 / 0.7241 / 0.7194 / 0.7119 / 0.7121** (mean 0.7176) — deterministic, EVERY pattern faster (x0.67–0.77). Independent 3-round confirmation: mean 0.7195 (−28.5%). ⇒ **mimalloc captures 73% of the (a) alloc ceiling (−29.2% of −40.0%) from a one-line allocator swap.**
- Honest caveat named: the never-free bump pays ~1 uncontended atomic (spinlock CAS) per alloc, so (a) is a slightly CONSERVATIVE (under-stated) ceiling of the pure malloc/free syscall cost.

**DECISIONS (engineer-owned, the director having DELEGATED the `.5` lever + the incremental-banking steer):**
- **(b) mimalloc LANDED (land-iff-faster satisfied: −29.2% deterministic, correctness-neutral by construction).** BANKED: the tracked regex COLD-parse closure floor is now **≈9.77µs ≈51×** (496µs → 9.77µs) with the RECOMMENDED production allocator (mimalloc-class); the platform-default (macOS libsystem_malloc) reference stays ≈13.8µs ≈36×. Landing MECHANISM (principled — a library MUST NOT impose a `#[global_allocator]` on its consumers; the README's own architecture): mimalloc stays a non-default `mimalloc_perf` feature (clean A/B-ability preserved + no C-dep forced on RGX's tree), and the landing is (1) the metric re-baseline, (2) the actionable RGX recommendation in the regex INTEGRATION CONTRACT + books, (3) `mimalloc_perf` established as the STANDARD closure-bench config. The campaign's ONGOING `.5` baseline probe is now the mimalloc build; all future levers are measured on top of it.
- **(a) CONFIRMED** ⇒ the `.5` deep-specialization roadmap PROCEEDS. RE-PRICED post-mimalloc (the stale-cost-basis lesson): mimalloc already captured 73% of the alloc ceiling, so the residual "perfect allocator" headroom is **mimalloc→nfa = 9769→8285 = −15.2%** of the mimalloc baseline. MTB-B's remaining alloc-axis win is the doomed fraction of that 15.2% (~−13.7%) PLUS the doomed CONSTRUCTION-COMPUTE elision (part of nfa's residual 8.29µs — value construction the bump still runs). So MTB-B is still worthwhile, but its dominant remaining value is CONSTRUCTION-compute elision, not the alloc syscall (mimalloc handled that). ⚠️ ≤1µs ARITHMETIC (honest, re-based): even a PERFECT allocator (the nfa floor) leaves **8.29µs ≫ 1µs** ⇒ the road MUST additionally attack the value-CONSTRUCTION compute (MTB-B doomed-elision + the committed-value REPRESENTATION change: serde `Value`/`BTreeMap` → spans/arena, the `-0091` bar-complete finding) and the matching/dispatch compute.
- **NEXT FRONTIER = MTB-B** (cyclic-spine fold + segment thin memo, ⛔ #49) built on the PRESERVED MTB-A tape infra (`scratchpad/mtb_a/` diff + reflog) — A+B land JOINTLY (A alone was flat only because the alloc BYTES live in the spine B folds), measured on the NEW mimalloc baseline, land-iff-faster; THEN the committed-value representation change; then re-census/re-profile #12. The `.6` `pgen_iteration_flow` remains the post-`.5` step.

#### `.5.i.7` RE-PROFILE #12 — THE MALLOC-FREE COMPUTE DECOMPOSITION (session #131, 2026-07-16, `PGEN-RGX-0078-0098`, docs-only scout): the perfect-allocator floor is VALUE-MACHINERY-dominated (construct+teardown+memops+alloc ≈ **66%**), matching/dispatch only ≈ **19%** ⇒ the construction-lever road (MTB-B doomed-elision + the committed-value REPRESENTATION change) is CONFIRMED and a matching pivot is REFUTED; SURFACED a cheap parser-agnostic win — a per-parse `getenv` (`PGEN_REPORT_MEMO_STATS`) at ≈**3%** in-metric → the next landing (`P-env`)

**WHY this profile (the roadmap's named re-profile #12, correctly positioned):** RE-PROFILE #11 was taken on the SYSTEM-MALLOC build, where `malloc`/`free` self-time (≈55.7%) masks the underlying COMPUTE split. STEP-0 (`-0097`) proved the value/alloc lever time-real (never-free-arena ceiling −40.0%, mimalloc landed −29.2%) and left the residual **8.29µs perfect-allocator floor ≫ 1µs** ⇒ the `≤1µs` bar MUST additionally attack value-CONSTRUCTION compute + the committed-value REPRESENTATION + matching/dispatch. The `-0094` MTB-A refutation + `-0097` re-pricing BOTH called for re-pricing MTB-B on a fresh model BEFORE its risky `ThinMemoEntry` core-type migration. This profile decomposes the malloc-free floor to decide **MTB-B (doomed construct) vs REPRESENTATION (committed construct) vs MATCHING (hard floor)** — probe-only (the `never_free_arena_perf` feature already exists; profiling changes no artifact; regex `8c26c97f` on disk untouched).

**THE INSTRUMENT (probe-only, macOS `/usr/bin/sample` @1ms on a NON-LTO + debuginfo build so function boundaries survive — fat-LTO inlines everything into `parse_full_regex`; two `#[global_allocator]` variants of `regex_perf_probe`, `--samples 6M`, `sample` for 18s, "Sort by top of stack" leaf categorization; artifacts under `docs/tasks/artifacts/reprofile12/`):**
- **NFA (never-free-arena = malloc-free — the clean COMPUTE decomposition), parse-only leaf self-time (14,976 samples):** CONSTRUCT **26.1%** · MATCH/DISPATCH **18.9%** · TEARDOWN/DROP **18.8%** · ALLOC(bump) **13.9%** · MEMOPS **7.4%** · UNKNOWN(dedup/outlined) **6.8%** · SEMANTIC-RT **4.9%** · ENV-LOOKUP **3.1%**.
- **MIMALLOC (the shipped-recommendation baseline), parse-only (14,941 samples):** CONSTRUCT **26.0%** · MATCH **17.6%** · TEARDOWN **15.3%** · UNKNOWN **14.5%** · ALLOC(mi_malloc/mi_free) **13.5%** · MEMOPS **6.5%** · SEMANTIC **3.8%** · ENV **2.7%**.

**ROBUST FINDINGS (hold regardless of the sampled-share/in-vs-out-metric caveats):**
1. **Value machinery dominates; matching does NOT.** construct+teardown+memops+alloc ≈ **66%** vs MATCH/DISPATCH ≈ **19%**. Even discounting ALL teardown as out-of-metric, in-metric construct(26)+alloc(14)+memops(7) ≈ **47% ≫ 19%** ⇒ the `.5` deep-specialization road (attack value construction/representation) is CONFIRMED; a pivot to the matching/dispatch compute is REFUTED (matching is near the floor already).
2. **The dominant construction signature is serde_json `Value` + `BTreeMap` + `String`** — the return-annotation JSON transform: `BTreeMap::clone_subtree`/`insert`/`entry`/`IntoIter`, `serde_json::value::Value` build+drop, `String::clone`, `Vec::clone`, `hashbrown insert`/`reserve_rehash`/`hash_one`. This IS the `-0091` bar-sharpening **committed-value REPRESENTATION lever** (serde `Value`/`BTreeMap` → spans/arena) — large, named, and attackable; it hits BOTH the committed (returned AST) AND doomed paths, so a cheaper representation shrinks doomed construction too.
3. **MTB-B re-priced on this model:** MTB-B elides DOOMED value CONSTRUCTION (in-metric), NOT the drop (TEARDOWN ≈18.8% is OUT-OF-METRIC — `time_one_parse` calls `elapsed()` before `node_arena`/`parser` drop; only the `let _ =` result-drop is in-metric). So MTB-B's min-metric win = the doomed fraction of CONSTRUCT(26%)+MEMOPS(7%)+ALLOC-residual, and its co-lever REPRESENTATION attacks the committed remainder. Both remain the road; both are heavy core-type migrations to be RE-PRICED again post-`P-env` on a fresh census — banked AFTER the cheap win below.

**🔎 THE SURFACED CHEAP WIN (`P-env`, the next landing — incremental-banking per director #129):** the profile pins a per-parse `getenv`. `RegexParser::parse()` reads `std::env::var("PGEN_REPORT_MEMO_STATS")` **twice per parse** (generated `regex_parser.rs:1201` in the `bare_parse` observability-twin routing compute + `:1203` post-parse) — call-graph `parse + 80 → std::env::var → getenv → __findenv_locked` (a LOCKED linear `environ` scan). Measured ≈**3.1%** of the parse (nfa; 2.7% on mimalloc), fully IN-METRIC (inside `parse_full_regex` → `parse`). It is **codegen-emitted (`ast_based_generator.rs:1740`/`2008`/`2026`) ⇒ PARSER-AGNOSTIC** (every generated parser pays it every parse). The flag is a process-launch diagnostic switch (no `set_var` of it exists anywhere in the tree — verified by grep), so hoisting it to a process-once `OnceLock<bool>` (the `mod.rs` `TRACE_OUTPUT_SINK`/`TRACE_FUNCTION_CACHE` precedent) is correctness-neutral BY CONSTRUCTION — the routing decision is identical for the whole process; byte-identical parse outputs; cert pins unchanged. → `P-env` landing slice: add a cached `report_memo_stats_enabled()` engine helper, emit calls to it, regen all 11, land-iff-faster on the mimalloc fat-LTO basis.

**CAVEATS (named, no silent caps):** (a) NON-LTO build ⇒ absolute times differ from the fat-LTO baseline; only the self-time SHARES are used (function-level decomposition). (b) SAMPLED-share ≠ min-metric (the P4-iii lesson) ⇒ these shares are DIRECTIONAL for the go/pivot decision, NOT a land-iff ceiling — the emission gate stays land-iff-faster on the fat-LTO 5×2000 geomean-of-mins for every increment. (c) TEARDOWN is split in-/out-of-metric (result-drop in, arena/parser-drop out) so the profile OVER-states the min-metric attackable surface for the drop buckets — accounted for in finding 3. (d) UNKNOWN (dedup/OUTLINED_FUNCTION/`???`) is 6.8%/14.5% — inlined helpers not symbol-attributable; it dilutes precision but not the coarse value-vs-match verdict.

#### `.5.i.7` P-env EMISSION — HOIST THE PER-PARSE `PGEN_REPORT_MEMO_STATS` `getenv` TO A PROCESS-ONCE CACHE (session #131, 2026-07-16, `PGEN-RGX-0078-0099`): the cheap parser-agnostic win RE-PROFILE #12 surfaced — banked FIRST (incremental-banking, director #129), before the heavy MTB-B / REPRESENTATION core-type migrations

**ROOT CAUSE (from RE-PROFILE #12, `-0098`):** every generated `parse()` reads `std::env::var("PGEN_REPORT_MEMO_STATS")` on the hot path — TWICE per parse: (1) in the `bare_parse` observability-twin routing compute (`ast_based_generator.rs:1740` → generated `regex_parser.rs:1201`), and (2) the post-parse memo-report gate (`ast_based_generator.rs:2008`/`2026` → generated `:1203`). Each is a `getenv`→`__findenv_locked` LOCKED linear `environ` scan. RE-PROFILE #12 (`/usr/bin/sample`, malloc-free build) priced the ENV-LOOKUP bucket at ≈**3.1%** of the parse (call-graph `parse + 80 → std::env::var → getenv → __findenv_locked`), fully IN-METRIC (`parse` runs inside `parse_full_regex`'s `elapsed()` region). Because it is CODEGEN-EMITTED, EVERY generated parser pays it EVERY parse (parser-AGNOSTIC).

**THE FIX (fix-hierarchy tier 5 = engine, minimal — a shared runtime helper + the codegen call):** add `pgen::ast_pipeline::report_memo_stats_enabled() -> bool`, a process-once `OnceLock<bool>` reading `PGEN_REPORT_MEMO_STATS` ONCE (the `mod.rs` `TRACE_OUTPUT_SINK`/`TRACE_FUNCTION_CACHE` precedent; `trace_verbosity` is already atomic-hoisted — memo-stats was the last per-parse env read). Codegen emits `crate::ast_pipeline::report_memo_stats_enabled()` at the 3 sites (the `bare_parse` clause becomes `&& !…enabled()`; the two report gates become `if …enabled()`). **Correctness-neutral BY CONSTRUCTION:** the flag is a process-launch diagnostic switch — grep confirms NO `set_var` of it exists anywhere in the tree, so it is a process-level constant; caching it changes no fused-vs-protocol routing decision and no parse output. Gates that exercise the memo-stats path set the env at process LAUNCH (before the first parse), so the cached first read is `true` for the whole process exactly as today.

**PLAN:** (1) add the helper to `mod.rs`; (2) edit the 3 codegen sites; (3) regen all 11 parsers canonically (bootstrap-safe order); (4) rebuild + full ⛔ correctness battery (AST 8/8 + outcome pins + cert seeds 0/7/42 + equivalence/combinator/semantic + ast-shape + duality + PCRE2 oracle + clippy source-strict); (5) MEASURE before→after on the mimalloc fat-LTO basis (alternated 5×2000 geomean-of-mins), land-iff-faster; (6) lockstep book scoreboard (a landed lever ⇒ a new `inside-parser-performance.md` row) + this leaf + TASK_TREE + MEMORY + CHANGES + DEV-NOTES.

#### `.5.i.7` REPRESENTATION DESIGN SCOUT — serde `Value`/`BTreeMap` → the arena-`Copy` `PgenValue<'input>` (session #135, opened 2026-07-16, `PGEN-RGX-0078-0103`, status: `done`, docs-only): the committed-value representation emission design, every constraint tool-verified before emission

**WHY (the `-0102` GO, mechanized into a design):** RE-PROFILE #13 confirmed the committed-value serde signature owns the attackable compute surface (CONSTRUCT 23.3% + TEARDOWN 13.3%, both serde-signed at the symbol level; matching 18.4% near-floor). This scout produces the emission DESIGN with every load-bearing constraint verified against the tree — no code change; the emission itself is `-0104+`.

**THE VERIFIED SURFACE (tools-first; each fact carries its locus):**
1. **The carrier:** `ParseContent::Json(serde_json::Value)` (`rust/src/ast_pipeline/mod.rs:756`); `to_json_value()` (`mod.rs:766–786`) allocates a `String` per `Terminal` conversion and DEEP-CLONES on `Json(value) => value.clone()`.
2. **The emitted cost pattern** (`generated/regex_parser.rs:2559–2582`, one of **912** `Map::new`/`to_json_value` sites in the regex artifact alone): per object a `serde_json::Map::new()` (BTreeMap) + `"key".to_string()` for **STATIC** template keys + a **DOUBLE DEEP-CLONE** per nested reference — `node.content.clone()` (clones the whole serde subtree) then `.to_json_value()` (clones it AGAIN). The profile's `String::clone` 516 / `BTreeMap::clone_subtree` 416 / `ParseContent::clone` 382 / `to_json_value` 271 / insert-family ≈773 are exactly this pattern.
3. **The emitters:** `ast_return_transform.rs` (877 lines; 18 `ParseContent::Json` sites — object/array/literal/property-access/`$ref` emission) + `ast_based_generator.rs` (10 sites). The `$text`/`MatchedText` path emits input slices (already zero-copy) — untouched.
4. **The boundary:** `parse_node_to_json` = `serde_json::to_value(node)` via `derive(Serialize)` (`parser_registry.rs:1549–1551`). `ParseContent`/`ParseNode` are **Serialize-ONLY** (zero `Deserialize` impls) ⇒ a twin variant carrying `#[serde(rename = "Json")]` is legal and the typed JSON carrier stays byte-identical.
5. **The metric:** `parse_full_regex` returns `ParseResult<ParseNode<'input>>` (artifact `:1570`); the probe stopwatch = construction + parse (+ mid-parse doomed/temp drops). Arena teardown is OUTSIDE the stopwatch but REAL for embedders (the embedding API keeps a dedicated drop-thread workaround for "deeply nested serde_json::Value Drop trees", `embedding_api.rs:1611`) — the lever removes that class too.
6. **Mid-parse value consumers (the adaptation set — all contained, verified):** shaped-view `$ref` flattening reads `String`/`Object`/`Array` to build FACT text (`unified_semantic_ast.rs:146–163`) → facts store **OWNED `String`s** (`SemanticRuntimeValue`, `semantic_runtime.rs:64`; `SemanticRuntimeState` `:2156` has NO lifetime parameter) ⇒ **no `'input` leakage into the store**; `value_compare` operates on `scalar_text` (`semantic_runtime.rs:3663`); the interpreter twin constructs `ParseContent::Json` at 12 sites (mirror same-slice); the regex typed hook (`parser_hooks/regex.rs`) is a separate per-rule surface with its own differential gate (consumes `to_json_value`, constructs no `ParseContent::Json`).
7. **Migration levers (verified against the `-0090` discipline):** artifacts import the LIB types (`use crate::ast_pipeline::{… ParseContent, ParseNode, MemoEntry, NodeArena …}`, artifact `:3`); `NodeArena` is consumed ONLY via `NodeArena::new()` + `.alloc(` (22,029 sites incl. artifacts; `typed_arena` referenced nowhere outside the alias at `mod.rs:746`) ⇒ the alias→struct swap is source-compatible and the emitted constructor signature `Parser::new(input, &arena, logger)` is UNCHANGED; adding a `ParseContent` variant is ADDITIVE (old artifacts keep compiling).

**THE DESIGN (the single recommendation):**
- **`PgenValue<'input>`** — a `Copy` arena value: `Null | Bool(bool) | Int(i64) | UInt(u64) | Float(f64) | Str(&'input str) | Array(&'input [PgenValue<'input>]) | Object(&'input [(&'input str, PgenValue<'input>)])`. Objects are key-SORTED + last-wins-deduped at build time (mirrors `BTreeMap` insert/iteration semantics byte-exactly); `Int/UInt/Float` mirror `serde_json::Number`'s internal `N` exactly.
- **Arenas:** `NodeArena` becomes a struct — the existing `typed_arena::Arena<ParseNode>` (with `new()`/`alloc()` signatures preserved) + value/pair slice arenas (`alloc_extend`, `Copy` payloads — no Drop) + an owned-`String` arena for the rare rendered strings (drop-correct). Created at the boundary exactly as today; `'input` unification per the `.5.d.4.i` precedent.
- **`ParseContent::Shaped(PgenValue<'input>)`** ADDED alongside `Json` with `#[serde(rename = "Json")]` + a manual `Serialize` on `PgenValue` mirroring `Value`'s (the SAME `serde_json` serializer performs escaping/ryu/itoa) ⇒ the released typed-AST carrier is **byte-identical — no schema bump, no contract-carrier change**. `Json` retires post-regen grep-proofed (the MTB-B `ThinMemoEntry` retirement pattern).
- **Semantics mirrored (the named edge set for the emission slice):** `Value::from(f64)` maps non-finite → `Null` (mirror at conversion sites); `TransformedTerminal` `from_str` can yield ANY JSON (incl. u64-range numbers and arrays) — same parse feeding `PgenValue` at those sites; duplicate-key = last-wins; variant-strict `PartialEq` (`Float(1.0) ≠ Int(1)`, as serde).
- **Eliminated in-metric:** BTreeMap node allocs + inserts, static-key `String` allocs, BOTH deep clones per reference (a `PgenValue` reference is `Copy`), `to_json_value` Terminal-`String` allocs, mid-parse doomed/temp `Value` drops, and the memo-hit deep-clone of shaped content. **Added:** arena bumps (the already-measured ALLOC bucket), small-object insertion sort/dedup, `from_str` where `TransformedTerminal` feeds shaped values; boundary dump paths pay one conversion OUT of the closure metric.

**THE FORK (surfaced per the amended fork rule; recommendation = (A), proceeding):** (A) the arena-`Copy` `PgenValue` above — eliminates the whole serde-signed class structurally; (B) serde-internal clone-elision (move instead of clone+clone, key reuse) — cheaper to build but leaves BTreeMap/String/drop costs and is structurally SUBSUMED by (A); (C) fully-lazy boundary shaping — highest ceiling but predicates/facts/`value_compare` need values DURING the parse ⇒ on-demand materialization machinery, highest risk; re-scoutable after (A) if the residual justifies.
