#### `.5.i.8.t1` INSTRUMENT DEFECT — the regex 3.4 entry-dump lane bypasses the D2-A counter-consumer routing (session #138, opened 2026-07-17, `PGEN-RGX-0078-0109`, status: `open`): `--dump-rule-entry-counts-json` ALONE serves the regex parse from the FUSED graph, undercounting to boundary-frames-only

**REPRODUCE (tool-backed, this session):** `parseability_probe --parse regex <literal_simple> --dump-rule-entry-counts-json` alone → `total_entries=5` (`letter`×4 + `regex`×1 — protocol-boundary frames only); the same invocation WITH `--dump-rule-outcome-counts-json` → entry dump `33` == outcome `33`. The TOOLBOX 3.4 ROUTING contract ("the fused cascade graph never serves a counted parse") is violated for regex-alone entry dumps. Blast radius: the regex dedicated-stack lane ONLY (other grammars use the `with_rule_entry_count_dump!` macro, whose pre-parse baseline grab fires the trigger); any regex 3.4-only dump taken since D2-B landed is boundary-only (this session's first `FUSIBILITY-ENTRY-SHARE` join read `total_entries=394`, `eliminated_below_roots=0` — an ARTIFACT of the defect, quarantined, not a finding).

**ROOT CAUSE (WHY + WHERE):** `parse_with_regex_detail` (`rust/src/parser_registry.rs`, the dedicated-stack worker closure) constructs a fresh parser and deliberately skips the pre-parse counter-baseline grab (zero baseline for a fresh parser — a valid *baseline* optimization) — but the macro path's baseline grab `parser.rule_call_counts()` is ALSO the D2-A routing side-channel: it sets `counters_observed` (`generated/regex_parser.rs:1107`), which `parse()` consults (`:1209–1211`, `bare_parse = … && !counters_observed.get()`). Without the grab, `bare_parse=true` ⇒ the fused cascade graph (which ticks no per-rule counters) serves the counted parse. The closure's only `rule_call_counts()` call is AFTER the parse, inside the dump-writer args — too late to route. (`enable_coverage()` masks it when the outcome dump is also requested, which is why 3.5 was correct all along.)

**FIX (engine-support tier, minimal):** fire the routing trigger pre-parse in the regex lane when the entry dump is requested — `if entry_dump.is_some() { let _ = parser.rule_call_counts(); }` with the WHY comment — mirroring the macro path's semantics exactly. TOOLBOX 3.4 ROUTING note gains the regex-lane parenthetical same-slice.

**RESULT — FIXED + VERIFIED (session #138).** The one-line pre-parse trigger landed in `parse_with_regex_detail` with the WHY comment; probe rebuilt under the guard (exit 0, peak 13,104MB < 16,384, 201s). VERIFIED: entry-alone `total_entries=33` == entry+outcome `33` == outcome `33` with **identical per-rule maps** on `literal_simple` (before: 5); the corrected 8-pattern re-dump reconciles entry Σ **1331 == outcome Σ 1331** with 8/8 accept parity. The corrected `FUSIBILITY-ENTRY-SHARE`: `eliminated_below_roots=37 at_roots=327 untouched=967 ceiling≈1.03x` — the quarantined 394-entry/1.00× artifact-read is superseded. TOOLBOX 3.4 + the book mirror (`parseability-probe-debug.md`) both carry the regex-lane parenthetical; `mdbook_docs_gate` green.

- **§5.d The D3 emission design (the `-0110` slice, parser-agnostic + capability-gated):**
  1. **Census gate = a SHARED plan function** (the census↔emission single-implementation lesson): `fusibility_census::compute_boundary_scanner_plan` — a rule qualifies iff (i) it is a PLAN-B protocol boundary (sub-root or residual), (ii) its text surface is scanner-encodable (the existing `.5.h` scanner-tier machinery reused; for residual rules the census must additionally verify the directive set ⊆ {matched-text `@transform`, read-only `@predicate`} evaluated post-match), (iii) no scope/fact effects (`@open_scope`/`@close_scope`/`@emit_fact` disqualify — they need the full frame), (iv) not the grammar entry.   2. **Emission:** per plan rule R, a direct-coded `scan_R(input, pos) → Option<(end, value)>` byte automaton producing the SAME `Shaped(PgenValue)` the protocol body folds (Terminal→`Str` span zero-copy; the `@transform` tail applies codegen's own numeric coercion; the `@predicate` tail consults the store read-only and can reject).   3. **Memo-loss soundness:** every plan rule is acyclic token-shaped ⇒ a lost memo hit re-runs an O(k) scan bounded by token length (no recursion ⇒ no ⛔-#49 thin-memo obligation); the current attackable hit surface is 40 hits/8 patterns (`digit` 25 + `letter` 15) and a byte-scan is cheaper than the hash-lookup+clone it replaces. Store-consulting `@predicate` tails re-evaluate fresh on every entry — sound-by-construction (≥ the epoch-validated replay guarantee).
  4. **C3-B + diagnostics parity obligations (named for `-0110`):** plan rules emit no facts and open no scopes (census-verified) ⇒ no snapshot/island changes at their call sites; `scan_R` returning None ≡ the rule failing at pos, and the emission owes **EXACT furthest-position emulation** per rule (the D1/Q-GUARD `first_set` precedent — the emitted guard must never report a shallower furthest byte than the protocol body would).
  5. **Verification battery (the standing land protocol):** regen all 11 via the `make focus_*` train → byte-compare tripwire on untouched grammars → differential-equivalence gate all-11 BEFORE the land decision → combinator 27/27 + semantic 36/36 → cert 0/7/42 + PCRE2 oracle tuple + shape/duality → the alternated fat-LTO 5×2000 geomean-of-mins land gate, land-iff-faster.

**DESIGN CARRIED IN (the `.5.i.8` §5.d contract, restated as implementation obligations):**
1. **SHARED plan fn** `fusibility_census::compute_boundary_scanner_plan` (census↔emission single implementation): a rule qualifies iff (i) PLAN-B protocol boundary (CyclicSpine sub-root or ineligible residual), (ii) scanner-encodable text surface (the census classifier's value-agnostic `shape_ok` half, with the residual's OWN allowed tail directives masked), (iii) directive set ⊆ {rule-level matched-text `@transform`, read-only post-phase `@predicate`} — `@emit_fact`/`@open_scope`/`@close_scope`/library/value-constraints/negative-case/follow-restrictions/mid-sequence actions/branch predicates all disqualify, (iv) non-entry, (v) value-reproducible fold, one of three CLASSES: **Text** (census text-folding ⇒ `Terminal(span)` — `nonzero_digit`/`digit`/`letter`/`name`/`capture_name`), **SpanTransform** (rule-level matched-text `@transform`, no return annotation ⇒ `TransformedTerminal(parsed.to_string())` — `quant_bound_number`/`backreference_digits`/`backreference_digits_single`), **ShapedObject** (static-key `-> {…}` template whose `$N` refs resolve to plan-rule references or terminals, + optional post read-only predicate ⇒ the SAME emitted template fold — `numeric_backreference`). Interior (non-plan) references must be recognizer-inlinable (`shape_ok`) — e.g. `quant_bound_number_body`/`quant_bound_core`/`unicode_char` are INLINED languages, not plan rules (value not text-folding or unreferenced-on-bare-path). Conservative under-approximation doctrine: any rule outside the vocabulary is dropped with a NAMED reason.
2. **Emission** (`scan_<rule>(&mut self) -> ParseResult<ParseNode<'input>>`, drop-in signature at both seams): frameless direct-coded matching over `self.position` (entry save, restore + `Backtrack{entry}` on fail) — no counter, no coverage, no trace, no recursion guard, no memo, no rule transaction, no tape. Value per class above; the `@transform` numeric coercion and the `-> {…}` template are the generator's OWN emissions reused. Post-`@predicate` tail resolves+evaluates via the SAME content-aware machinery, read-only, fresh on every entry (≥ the epoch-validated replay guarantee; no store mutation by the plan gate).
3. **Call-site dispatch:** (a) fused `cascade_*` match bodies (bare-path-only by construction): boundary reference to a plan rule → `parser.scan_<r>()?` + the unchanged boundary-vec push; (b) protocol bodies: `if parser.bare_parse { parser.scan_<r>() } else { <existing inlined-frame/method emission, byte-VERBATIM> }`. The plan rules' OWN methods stay VERBATIM (the protocol twin; every diagnostic consumer routes there exactly as since D2-A).
4. **EXACT furthest-position emulation** (the D1/Q-GUARD precedent, hard obligation): `furthest` rides ONLY on rule-frame entries (verified: `match_string`/`match_regex`/builtins never touch it) ⇒ scan emits the update at scan entry + at EVERY inlined interior rule-entry point, with the SAME per-site dispatch decisions (byte-switch vs tournament) as the shipped emitters so attempted-branch rule entries agree position-for-position. Or-tournament under longest_match reduces in scan to max-end + attempt side effects (values are span-derived ⇒ winner-index-independent).
5. **Memo-loss soundness:** every plan rule acyclic token-shaped (census-verified) ⇒ O(k) re-scan bounded by token length; current attackable hit surface 40 hits/8 patterns; no ⛔-#49 obligation.
6. **Verification battery (the standing land protocol):** regen all 11 via `make focus_*` → byte-compare tripwire on untouched grammars → differential-equivalence all-11 BEFORE the land decision → combinator 27/27 + semantic 36/36 → cert 0/7/42 + PCRE2 oracle tuple + shape/duality → alternated fat-LTO 5×2000 geomean-of-mins land gate, land-iff-faster.

**RESULT — LANDED (−15.5%, the cost model CONFIRMED inside its recorded band).** The D3 emission is COMPLETE per the design: the SHARED census gate `fusibility_census::compute_boundary_scanner_plan` (three value classes + named drop reasons + the `BOUNDARY-SCANNER-PLAN` census report, TOOLBOX 5.3), the scan emitter (`ast_based_generator/scan.rs` — frameless `scan_<rule>` fns + per-interior-rule `scan_rec_*` recognizer helpers + the read-only `scan_post_predicate_gate` tail; every guard/dispatch decision reuses the protocol emitters' OWN helpers (`degenerate_dispatch_byte_sets`/`first_set_prune_guard_for_branch`/`quantified_prune_guard_for_element`), so byte-switch-vs-tournament and Q-guard/FIRST-prune structure — and therefore rule-entry furthest updates — agree position-for-position BY SHARED IMPLEMENTATION; the value folds reuse `generate_post_body_span_transform` and `generate_return_transform` verbatim), and the two call-site seams (fused `cascade_*` bodies dispatch unconditionally — they are bare-path-only; protocol bodies dispatch on `bare_parse` with the protocol arm byte-VERBATIM). The emitted regex plan = **19 rules (13 text / 5 span_transform / 1 shaped_object; 13 sub-roots / 6 residual; 1 predicated) + 6 recognizer helpers; 40 candidates dropped, every reason named** — the full `-0108` attack population plus the equally-qualifying `callout_number`/`digits`/directive-name family (`docs/tasks/artifacts/d3_bench/boundary_scanner_plan.txt`).
- **MEASURED (the land gate, fat-LTO alternated 5×2000 geomean-of-mins, mimalloc; probes base `7310ed73` PRESERVED-shipped / cand `63c227b1`):** **6181.0ns → 5224.4ns = −15.5%**; per-round ratios `0.849/0.856/0.849/0.848/0.845`; per-pattern best-mins `0.744–0.904` (`digit_sequence` −25.6% — the digit-heavy attack cluster, as the model predicted) — EVERY round and EVERY pattern faster; an independent same-binaries run measured −14.3% (band honest). - **🔎 DEFECT CAUGHT MID-SLICE by the equivalence oracle (the `-0101` `$text` precedent repeated — the gate ran BEFORE the land decision, as designed):** the first all-11 battery failed `certified_grammars_are_byte_identical` on SV `timeunit` samples (`"body":"59"` vs `" 59"`). WHY+WHERE: the Text-class scan folded `Terminal(&input[start..end])` (the whole span), but for an UNANNOTATED token-fold rule in a layout-SKIPPING grammar the protocol folds the TOKEN text — the span includes skipped leading trivia (regex is whitespace-sensitive, so its 16/16 tripwire could not see it). FIX (census-gate tier): the Text class requires the explicit `-> $text` span fold on every branch (span semantics BY DECLARATION, layout-independent) OR a skip-free closure (`!skipping_atom` ⇒ span == token text by construction); token-folds over skipping closures drop with the named reason. Same-slice, two sibling mirror refinements found against the real grammar: the SpanTransform class mirrors the emitter's OWN splice conditions (non-`Or` roots only; single REGEX-terminal bodies are atom-path), and the post-predicate raw gate mirrors `needs_positional_raw_post_capture_for_rule` (the RAWCAP-TRANSFORM-PATH.2 narrow gate the emitted body actually consults — named refs resolve against shaped content, which is exactly what the scan tail passes for both views).
- **Soundness notes (named in-code):** scan speculation is plain position-restore (the plan audit proves scan closures reach no store effect; read-only predicate evaluation needs no rollback); predicate-bearing scans re-evaluate FRESH on every entry (≥ the epoch-validated replay guarantee), and an ENCLOSING bare-path memo entry that observes the extra evaluations is taint-stamped — strictly MORE conservative caching, never less; Or tournaments in scan reproduce the full `(end, priority, index)` winner chain so priority/associativity policies stay byte-exact even though values are span-derived.
- **⚠️ OPS FINDING (pre-existing gate hygiene, recorded — not this slice's code):** `regex_typed_differential_gate`'s step-3 restore (`… 2>/dev/null || true`) failed SILENTLY mid-battery and left the `--enable-parser-hooks` emit on disk; caught by hash-tripwiring the artifact (`d2decb51` → `193ab5be`), restored by the deterministic canonical regen (`d2decb51` reproduced byte-exact), and the 3 downstream gates re-ran green on the canonical artifact. The candidate probe proved byte-identical from both vintages (the hooks delta is dead code under fat-LTO), so the bench verdict was never contaminated. Follow-up candidate: surface the restore failure loudly in the gate recipe.

- **§5 The emission design (the `.5.i.12` slice, parser-agnostic + capability-gated on literal BYTES only — no grammar-name gates):**
  1. **Eligibility gate (ONE shared decision point, the census↔emission single-implementation lesson):** a literal qualifies iff all bytes < 0x80 AND 1 ≤ len ≤ 8, decided by one small shared fn consumed by every emission site; non-eligible literals keep `match_string` VERBATIM (8 non-ASCII + 520 ≥5B sites platform-wide stay untouched).
  2. **Form:** ONE const-generic runtime helper emitted once per parser — `#[inline(always)] fn match_lit_ascii<const N: usize>(&mut self, lit: &'static str, bytes: &[u8; N]) -> ParseResult<&'input str>`; body: (a) compile-time layout prelude for skip grammars (`consume_layout_for_terminal(lit)` — regex is non-skip ⇒ absent); (b) **cold trace fallback FIRST**: `if self.logger_enabled { return self.match_string(lit); }` — trace output stays byte-EXACT through the existing primitive, and the bench path never takes the branch (**`bare_parse ⇒ !logger_enabled ⇒ !trace_enabled` proven at artifact `:1209`/`:1175`**); (c) bounds-guarded const-width compare `start + N <= len && &bytes[start..start+N] == expected` (LLVM lowers const-N to direct byte/u16/u32 compares — NO libc call); (d) success ⇒ `self.position = start + N; Ok(&input[start..end])`; fail ⇒ `Err(ParseError::Backtrack { position: start })` — bit-identical to `match_string`'s Optim-#4 contract. Call-site swap `match_string("x")` → `match_lit_ascii::<1>("x", b"x")` at the FOUR live emission sites: `generate_atom_logic` quoted_string (`ast_based_generator.rs:5203`) + number/…/rule (`:5412`) + the two scan-emitter sites (`scan.rs:431`, `:846`); `constraint_guards` bindings unchanged (same `matched_str`). The legacy `ast_code_generator.rs` twin is NOT touched (bootstrap-only surface, perf-irrelevant).
  3. **BOUNDARY-ELISION PROOF (recorded — the `-0113` claim generalized from 1-byte to ALL-ASCII):** for an all-ASCII literal of length k that byte-matches at `[start, start+k)`: the byte at `start` is < 0x80 ⇒ NOT a UTF-8 continuation byte ⇒ `start` is a char boundary; every matched byte is a complete 1-byte scalar ⇒ `start+k` follows a complete char ⇒ also a boundary. Both `is_char_boundary` checks are provably TRUE whenever the compare succeeds — the guarded internal-error branch is UNREACHABLE for the eligible population and its elision is behavior-identical.
  4. **Soundness inventory:** `match_string` never touches `furthest` (verified at D3 §4) ⇒ exact furthest-position emulation is trivial; no memo/coverage/counter interaction (terminal primitive, not a rule frame); failure position = post-layout `start` exactly as today; the compare is the SAME `bytes_match_at` semantics with N const.
  5. **Size budget (census-measured):** per-site delta ≈ +15 bytes; worst artifact SV = 513 sites ≈ +8KB on 68.9MB ≈ **+0.01%**; helper ≈ 20 lines once per parser; monomorphization ≤ 8 instantiations (N=1…8). No budget mechanism needed (3 orders below the P1a 192-weight regime).
  6. **Verification battery (the standing land protocol):** regen all 11 via `make focus_*` → byte-compare tripwire on untouched grammars → differential-equivalence gate all-11 BEFORE the land decision → combinator + semantic suites → cert 0/7/42 + PCRE2 oracle tuple + shape/duality → the alternated fat-LTO 5×2000 geomean-of-mins land gate, land-iff-faster. ⚠️ **The battery + land gate = the PARKED heavy-build class ⇒ the `.5.i.12` slice needs a DIRECTOR GO (the Terminal-split mechanism, 3-for-3).**
- **§6 GO/NO-GO: GO for `.5.i.12`** — LOW −3.7% clears the land-gate round-spread noise (±0.4%) ≈9×; the population is census-located per site with a 100%-of-dynamic-attempts eligibility footprint; every soundness obligation is named with its landed precedent; the design adds ZERO new observable surfaces (trace routes through the existing primitive).

The safe int-compare captures the located "STRING-compare" cost without either hazard.
  - **Emission choice (to keep legacy + bootstrap byte-untouched — the recommended path):** Rust has no overloading, so ADD id-aware `check_cycle_id(RuleId, &str, usize)` / `enter_id(RuleId, &str, usize)` methods used only by the protocol + cascade emitters; keep the old `check_cycle`/`enter` (name-scan) for the legacy bootstrap generator. `parse_stack` carries the id in both paths (old `enter` pushes a placeholder id, e.g. `RuleId::MAX`; a given parser uses ONE emitter consistently ⇒ no mixing). `exit()` is name/id-agnostic (LIFO pop) ⇒ unchanged. #### `.5.i.16` FIRST-BYTE-INDEXED SPINE DISPATCH STEP-0 — the census/pricing/design scout (session #147, 2026-07-18, `PGEN-RGX-0078-0121`, status: `done` — census + honest price + emission design complete; docs+evidence-only, ZERO builds; ⭐ STRATEGIC FORK SURFACED to the director — see the steering block): size and design the #16 steering's №1 lever

**WHY (the `-0120` steering's №1):** RE-PROFILE #16 measured the spine tournament/dispatch self-time at `cascade_match_piece` 5.6% + `cascade_match_atom` 5.6% = **11.2% in-window** — the hottest coherent NON-construction surface after `-0115`/`-0118` removed match_string and the spine machinery. Mechanism (located this scout): every cascade tournament execution evaluates its per-branch first-byte guards **SEQUENTIALLY and EXHAUSTIVELY** — `longest_match` has no early exit, so every guarded branch pays its `matches!(bytes[parse_start], SET)` set-membership test on every execution (at `atom`: 24 branches × 24 tests per exec while a mean of only **1.62** branches survive on the bench bytes). The lever: replace the K sequential set tests with **ONE 256-entry LUT load** (byte → surviving-branch bitmask) + per-survivor bit-iteration (`trailing_zeros` + jump), preserving tournament order and semantics byte-identically by construction.

**INSTRUMENTS (read-only, ZERO builds — the `-0116` precedent; every binary pre-existing):** (1) probe behavioral custody PROVEN: fresh `--dump-rule-entry-counts-json`/`--dump-rule-outcome-counts-json` over the 8 bench patterns are **cmp-BYTE-IDENTICAL 8/8** to the `-0116` banked dumps (machinery-only `-0118` moved no entry structure — the standing cross-validation); (2) **NEW dynamic survivor instrument**: `PGEN_TRACE_VERBOSITY=debug --trace` per pattern — the `Entering branch k/N for rule 'r' at position p` line fires INSIDE `try_parse`, i.e. only for guard-PASSING attempts ⇒ counting them = the exact per-rule SURVIVOR population; `Memo miss for rule <id> at position <p>` = the body-execution population that pays the full guard chain today (PROTOCOL-graph observability; the standing `.5.i.9` boundary-join caveat; trace determinism `cmp`-clean); (3) static census `census_dispatch.py`: every tournament instance in every `cascade_match_*` fn, per-branch guard byte-sets extracted (guarded/unguarded/FIRST₂ conjuncts), per-byte survivor tables + distinct-mask counts, LOUD on any unparsed guard shape.

**🔎 STEP-2 PRE-EMISSION FINDING (session #150, 2026-07-18): the `-0124` STEP-1 partition is UNSOUND for CONTENT-CARRYING barriers — on the regex HOT SPINE — corrected BEFORE any emission (the [[feedback_be_alert_root_cause_fishy_immediately]] + design-before-emission discipline):**
- **WHY+WHERE (static, from the landed code + grammar + banked artifacts):** `return_ast_is_fold_barrier` (`fusibility_census.rs:3185`) returns `true` for `Array`/`ArrayAccess`/`QuantifiedExtraction` (and array-embedded `Spread`/`FlattenSpread`), and the demand walk stops at every barrier. But those transforms RE-EMIT CHILD CONTENT/NODES in their output (`generate_array_transform` pushes child `ParseNode`s / clones child content into `ParseContent::Sequence`; `ast_return_transform.rs:192-353`) — they are NOT variant-independent folds. Concrete regex instance: `concatenation := piece+ -> [$1**]` (`grammars/regex.ebnf:94`) is classified `barrier` (banked `census_regex_dvp_rules.txt`), yet it is DEMANDED through the all-transparent chain `pattern -> $1` → `alternation` (no annotation) → `alternative` (no annotation) — all three `node_locked` in the banked verdicts — so its content (`Sequence` of spread-pushed **piece nodes**, `rule_name`+`span`+content observable through the escape surfaces) must stay byte-exact; but `piece` is classified `value_licensed` (node build elided). The landed plan simultaneously requires piece nodes (for concatenation's verbatim content) and licenses their elision — inconsistent; a naive STEP-2 emission would either break byte-exactness or dead-lock on the partition.
- **THE CORRECTION (single recommendation, PROCEEDED-ON per the 2026-07-15 fork-discipline amendment; census single-implementation, so report + emitter cannot drift):** (1) the 2-way barrier test becomes a **3-way per-branch fold class** — `ValuePure` (`Object`/scalar literals/`Identifier`/`PropertyAccess`/`MatchedText`/rule-level `@transform`: every child reference consumed as a folded VALUE) / `ContentCarrying` (`Array`/`Spread`/`FlattenSpread`/`ArrayAccess`/`QuantifiedExtraction`: output re-emits child content or nodes) / `Transparent` (`$N`/passthrough/missing). (2) **Demand propagates PER-REFERENCE**: from a demanded rule, only the references its transform consumes in CONTENT position — a `Transparent-$N` branch demands exactly element N−1's subtree references; `Transparent`-passthrough and `ContentCarrying` branches demand the whole branch body's references; `ValuePure` branches demand NOTHING (their folds consume child values; compositionality license unchanged). `barrier` narrows to `ValuePure`-on-every-branch. (3) A **vocabulary audit** with NAMED-reason demotion to `node_locked` (the D3 `ScanAudit` precedent): value-form emission licensed only where every static decision is resolvable (v1 demotes `ArrayAccess`/`QuantifiedExtraction`-carrying rules and `Spread`/`FlattenSpread` whose base content-variant or item content-class is not statically decidable — a `Spread` distinguishes `Sequence`/`Quantified` from `Shaped(Array)` at runtime, and a `FlattenSpread` item carrying `TransformedTerminal` JSON-array text would splice where today it nests; both decidable only with static shape knowledge).
- **THE 2a EMISSION (consistent with per-reference demand — per-BRANCH modes, so a mixed rule like `piece` keeps its object-branch elision):** `value_licensed` (undemanded, in-vocabulary) → `cascade_build_value_R() -> PgenValue` (zero nodes; `Sequence`/`Quantified`→`Array`, absent-`?`/`Lookahead`→`Array(&[])`, terminal→`Str` span slice, fused node-form child → STACK node + `content.to_shaped_value` (Alternative-wrapper arena alloc elided), boundary → splice + fold). `barrier` (ValuePure-all-branches) → node-signature fn, content = `Shaped`/`Terminal` built by IN-PLACE value extraction (no body scaffolding; byte-exact by fold compositionality). `node_locked` → node fn with PER-BRANCH modes: ValuePure branch → in-place `Shaped` content; `Transparent-$N` branch → in-place content-mode build of element N−1 ONLY (the `$1`-peel's dead `Alternative` arena alloc elided too) + discard-mode walkers for the other elements (advance `deriv_pos`; stack-build-and-discard for refs); `ContentCarrying`/passthrough/demoted branches → verbatim (their references are exactly the demanded ones — partition↔emission consistency by construction, with a loud codegen bail if a verbatim site ever references a value-form rule). STEP-2b (opened as the follow-on): in-place input feeding for demanded `ContentCarrying` folds (concatenation's iteration-wrapper + Vec elision) + any vocabulary widening the populations justify.
- **HONEST IMPACT:** the corrected regex partition shifts the carrying chain (`concatenation`, `piece`→branch-1's `piece_quoted_run_quantified` target, + `alternation`/`alternative` already locked) toward `node_locked`; the elidable population drops from the recorded 92.1% but the TOP wrapper frames (`literal` 85 / `class_atom` 82 / `literal_char` 80 / `atom` / `escape_unit` / `counted_quantifier` / `quant_base` value forms; `piece`'s six object branches in-place) survive via the per-branch modes. Exact corrected populations re-derived and re-recorded when the corrected census runs; the STEP-0 price bands stand as the MODEL with the achieved-fraction restated against the corrected partition (falsification discipline unchanged).

**⭐ STEP-0 ROOT CAUSE (session #153, `PGEN-RGX-0078-0135` — the superlinear mechanism PINNED, toolbox-first; evidence `docs/tasks/artifacts/worst_cell_rootcause/`): the C3-B tournament delta protocol does O(inner fact-store) work per Or-boundary — quadratic in group-nesting depth.**
- **Instrument chain:** depth-ladder corpus (39 synthetic rows: `flat`/`nest`/`nestbr`/`look`/`lookstar` series + the two originals) timed on the floor-validated `-0132` release probe (`7fd0a31b`, bare closure path); entry/outcome dumps via a fresh HEAD-coherent debug `parseability_probe` (rebuilt against the `-0129` artifacts, guard peak 10329 MB); `/usr/bin/sample` @1ms×10s leaf categorization on `nest_80` (the re-profile method).
- **Elimination facts:** `nest_80` (161 B, NO backref) 2,128,042 ns ≈ `orig_4674` 2,120,833 ns ⇒ the `\80` backreference is IRRELEVANT — pure capturing-group nesting is the whole 4674 mechanism; `6538_noquant` 91,375 ≈ `orig_6538` 92,042 ns ⇒ the `{26}` is irrelevant; `flat` control LINEAR (~165 ns/B).
- **The discriminator:** rule ENTRIES are LINEAR in depth (132/252/492/972 at d=10/20/40/80 — no structural re-parse, no backtracking blowup) while wall time is QUADRATIC (1,097→13,218 ns/B) ⇒ per-entry cost grows with depth.
- **The mechanism (counter-pinned):** `facts_emitted ≈ 2d²` with only d net facts (240/880/3,360/13,120; `facts_rolled_back` matching; tournament rollbacks 3/level, 241/243 slow-path at d=80). Every `(` emits `regex_capture_group` facts (`grammars/regex.ebnf:1459/1491/1493` — the backref/conditional validation surface); at each nesting level ~3 spine Or-tournament sites run the full C3-B cycle over the ENTIRE inner fact set: `extract_delta_since` clones the k inner `SemanticFactRecord`s + the FULL `active_chain`+`scopes` (`semantic_runtime.rs:2765`, the unconditional `final_*` clones :2824-2825) → slow `rollback_to_labeled` (k× `FactIndex::remove`, each a `to_ascii_lowercase` alloc + `FactNameKey` String clone + 2 SipHash hashes, :1980) → winner `apply_delta` re-inserts all k through the same path (:2834/:2865 — the re-emission counter). Σ = O(d²) ≈ 39k heavy fact-ops @ d=80 ≈ ~53 ns/op.

**⭐ K1 STEP-1 DESIGN (session #153, `PGEN-RGX-0078-0136` — recorded BEFORE emission, the house discipline): WINNER-IN-PLACE TOURNAMENT COMMIT (lazy C3-B branch cleanup).**
- **The emission site:** the island Or-tournament loop `ast_based_generator.rs` ~4640–4830 (per successful branch: UNCONDITIONAL `extract_delta_since` → `rollback_to_labeled(C3bBranchCleanup)` → `should_take`-gated stash into `best_semantic_delta`; post-loop `apply_delta(best)` at :4822-4824). The P2 DEGENERATE BYTE-SWITCH (:4260) already elides the whole protocol where FIRST-disjointness proves ≤1 candidate — but the nest chain's `group`-class sites can NEVER qualify (every branch shares the `(` first byte), so they run this loop; K1 is the lazy protocol for exactly the sites P2 cannot serve.
- **The restructure (same loop shape, one new flag `live_semantic_branch: bool`):** (1) BEFORE an attempted branch's body parse: if the current best's effects are live → `best_semantic_delta = Some(extract_delta_since(cp))` + `rollback_to_labeled(cp, C3bBranchCleanup)` + `live=false` (deferred cleanup — byte-PRUNED branches skip body AND cleanup, nothing evaluates). (2) On success + `should_take`: NO extract, NO rollback — `live=true`, `best_semantic_delta=None` (previous best's delta dropped). (3) On success + `!should_take`: `rollback_to_labeled` ONLY (the loser's delta is never consumed — today's unconditional extract for losers is pure waste, eliminated). (4) Post-loop: `live` ⇒ COMMIT IN PLACE (zero extract/rollback/apply — the winner's effects were never rolled back); else `apply_delta(best)` as today. (5) The `nonassoc_tie` whole-choice-failure arm + the no-branch-succeeded arm gain `if live { rollback }`.
- **Soundness invariants (each an audit obligation):** (a) BRANCH ISOLATION preserved — every attempted body starts from the checkpoint store state (deferred cleanup runs before any body that will execute; at most ONE branch's effects are ever live, and only the current best's). (b) END-STATE IDENTITY — in-place = checkpoint + winner's effects at the SAME master-Vec positions/scope-arena indices the rollback+reapply path reproduces; obligations keep enqueue order; C3-B "successful-but-losing branch's emissions must not persist" preserved by (3). (c) WRITE-EPOCH: the in-place path skips the rollback+apply epoch bumps — entries stamped during the winner's body stay valid LONGER, soundly (the store state genuinely never changed; MEMO-STORE-SOUNDNESS.2's equality validation licenses replay exactly then); memo hit/rollback COUNTERS change (diagnostic-only — recorded, not gated). (d) The interpreter stays UNCHANGED this slice (K1 is result-invariant, so interp/codegen stay byte-identical through every oracle; protocol-internal divergence is invisible to the equivalence/combinator/semantic gates — recorded as a deliberate scope decision). (e) The memo success-insert extraction (`ast_based_generator.rs:8403`) is OUT of K1's scope = **K1b**, priced by the post-K1 re-profile (its clones are epoch-invalidated dead weight whenever a later rollback removes the extracted facts — a provable-waste candidate).

**⭐ K1c STEP-0 + DESIGN (session #154, `PGEN-RGX-0078-0138` — recorded BEFORE emission, the house discipline): the `piece`-class survivor is EXACTLY the branch-7 post-winner attempt; kill = GRAMMAR-TIER LEFT-FACTORING of the shared `atom` prefix (fix-hierarchy tier 1).**

- **WHY branch 7 is always doomed-but-attempted:** `zero_width` = ONLY `\E` / `\Q\E` (`regex.ebnf:224` — backslash-first), so branch 7 (`atom zero_width+ quantifier`, the `x\E*` quantifier-through-transparency absorption branch, `:163`) shares the full `atom` FIRST-prefix with branch 6 and is byte-UNPRUNABLE wherever atom is; after branch 6 wins, branch 7 re-parses atom (via memo replay + full delta traffic) then fails on the next byte ≠ `\`.
- **THE KILL (grammar tier — EBNF stays the sole SoT; both emitters + the interpreter get it FOR FREE from the gen-AST):** merge branches 6+7 into one branch with a factored tail:
  `piece = … 5 unchanged branches … | atom piece_tail -> {type:"piece", atom:$1, quantifier:$2}` with `piece_tail = quantifier? -> $1 | zero_width+ quantifier -> $2` (arm order mirrors old 6-before-7; ties are impossible — arm 2 starts with a backslash form `quantifier` can never parse, so order is belt-and-braces only).

Old branch 6 can never fail after atom succeeds (`quantifier?` is total) = new merged branch. AST per class: `a`→`quantifier:[]` (arm-1 `$1` passthrough of the empty optional), `a*`→the unwrapped quantifier object (arm-1 passthrough of the present optional), `x\E*`→arm-2 `$2` = the bare quantifier (old `$3`), zero_widths dropped as today.
- **WHY it kills the residual:** the merged branch is the LAST byte-viable `piece` branch on atom-prefix input ⇒ after it wins, `live` stays true ⇒ ZERO deferred cleanup + in-place commit (K1's best case). Atom's k facts sit OUTSIDE the `piece_tail` tournament — never extracted/rolled back/re-applied; atom parses ONCE (no re-attempt ⇒ no memo replay ⇒ the K1b nest-family population also dies). The tail tournament is store-PURE on the common path (`@emit_fact` exists only at capture-group opens `:1459/:1491/:1493`; quantifier/zero_width emit nothing) ⇒ its arm-2 losing attempt is an `rollbacks_tournament_unchanged` fast-path at worst. **⭐ K4a STEP-1 DESIGN (session #158, `PGEN-RGX-0078-0149` — recorded BEFORE emission, the house discipline): SLIM `Copy` CHECKPOINT via a WAM-STYLE CHAIN TRAIL — kill the per-attempt ~88-B non-`Copy` checkpoint construct/copy/drop (the `-0148`-pinned 8.1% MAX population) AND the depth≥2 chain clone (the 7.5% `line_2880` population) with ONE mechanism.**
- **The design decision (one recommendation, trail over epoch-only):** an epoch-only `(chain_len, chain_epoch)` snapshot cannot RESTORE chain content after a real mutation (a popped ScopeId is gone) — it would need a content fallback exactly where today's cost is. The **undo trail** gives O(1) checkpoints AND exact restores: `chain_trail: Vec<ChainTrailOp>` on the state, `enum ChainTrailOp { Pushed, Popped(ScopeId), Replaced(ActiveChain) }`; every chain mutation appends its inverse-enabling record. Trail-len equality ⟺ zero chain mutations since checkpoint (the trail is append-only within a speculation; only rollback unwinds truncate it) — a strictly exact O(1) guard replacing the O(len) content compare.
- **THE CHANGE (lib-only, `semantic_runtime.rs`; artifacts byte-UNTOUCHED — the K3b/K3d class; emitted code audited: 0 mentions of the TYPE, only `.checkpoint()`/`.fact_len()` accessor calls):** `SemanticRuntimeCheckpoint` drops `active_chain_snapshot: ActiveChain` (its only non-`Copy` field, per the struct's own `:1937` comment) for `chain_len: usize` + `chain_trail_len: usize` ⇒ **7 words, `#[derive(Clone, Copy)]`, no Drop glue, register-class argument passing**. `checkpoint()` records lens only (zero clones at ANY depth — the K3d sentinel machinery is SUBSUMED and removed). The rollback + extract fast-path guards split `#[inline]` guard / `#[cold]` outlined slow path so the ~20k/parse unchanged case costs a compare-and-return at the call site.
- **The four mutation sites (tool-verified at HEAD) each gain one trail append:** `open_scope` push `:3418` → `Pushed`; `close_scope` pop `:3442` → `Popped(id)`; `apply_delta` wholesale replace `:3056` → `Replaced(mem::replace(chain, delta.final_active_chain))` (zero-copy move of the old chain into the trail); the labeled-rollback restore is NOT a mutation — it is the UNWIND (pop trail entries above `cp.chain_trail_len`, applying inverses in place: `Pushed`⇒pop, `Popped(id)`⇒push(id), `Replaced(old)`⇒assign old by move), then the existing closed-flag re-open loop + `scopes` rebuild run unchanged on the restored chain.
- **CONSUMER AUDIT (every `active_chain_snapshot` read, mapped to the trail):** (1) extract fast-path debug_assert `:2963` + rollback fast-path debug_assert `:3125` → `trail.len() == cp.chain_trail_len` asserts (exact, stronger than content-equality); (2) the extract slow-path `closed_scope_ids` filter `:2986-2991` → reconstruct the checkpoint chain into a local (clone current + inverse-walk the trail above `cp.chain_trail_len` — `&self` method, slow path only, O(mutations)) then filter as today; (3) the two change-guards `:3159`/`:3254` → `trail.len() != cp.chain_trail_len`; (4) the restore `:3266-3270` → the in-place unwind above; (5) the `rollbacks_nonempty_chain` counter `:3133`/`:3180` → `cp.chain_len > 1` (meaning preserved exactly — "non-root chain at checkpoint" — the `-0147` pin + positive-direction test carry over unchanged); (6) the transaction accessor `checkpoint()` `:4127` (`self.checkpoint.clone()`) compiles unchanged (`clone()` on a `Copy` type); (7) the delta carrier `final_active_chain` (`:2968`/`:3004`) deliberately OUT of scope = **K4b** (the extract-side clones — recorded residual, the 2880 slow legs). Trail lifecycle: cleared in `new`/`reset`; grows with net un-unwound scope ops per parse (regex: ~2/lookaround; bounded by input everywhere — honest note, no truncation on commit BY DESIGN since an outer speculation may still unwind past committed ops, the same LIFO discipline today's snapshots rely on).

NEXT = `-0150` K4a emission.

**⭐ V1 M3 STEP-1 DESIGN (session #160, `PGEN-RGX-0078-0155` — recorded BEFORE emission, the house discipline): M3 = STACK-INLINE CONVERSION BUFFER — the transient heap `Vec` in `ParseContent::to_shaped_value`'s `Sequence`/`Quantified` arm becomes a `SmallVec<[PgenValue; 8]>`; LIB-ONLY (the runtime-shared conversion — artifacts byte-untouched), value-identical BY CONSTRUCTION.**
- **The mechanism (WHY+WHERE, tool-verified at HEAD):** `rust/src/ast_pipeline/mod.rs:1097-1115` — every `Sequence`/`Quantified` conversion `collect()`s a transient heap `Vec<PgenValue>`, hands it to `arena.alloc_shaped_values` (which copies it into the arena), then frees the buffer. The `Vec` exists ONLY for the re-entrancy constraint (the `:1107` comment): `typed_arena::Arena::alloc_extend` drains its iterator while holding the arena's internal borrow, and per-child conversion re-enters the arena — children MUST be fully materialized before the arena call. But the materialization does not need the HEAP: the buffer's lifetime is one conversion call, `PgenValue` is a 24-byte `Copy` enum, and the census avg is **1.27 elements/conversion** (`m1_recensus_output.txt`: `line_725` 2,967 conversions / 3,774 items) — the per-conversion **malloc+free round-trip is the dominant constant**, exactly the K3b `ActiveChain` lever class (`-0142`: per-call heap round-trip elided by SmallVec inline storage).
- **THE CHANGE (one arm, lib-only; `smallvec` already a lib dep — `rust/Cargo.toml:142`, the `-0118` C3 precedent):** `let converted: SmallVec<[PgenValue<'input>; 8]> = nodes.iter().map(|node| node.content.to_shaped_value(arena)).collect(); PgenValue::Array(arena.alloc_shaped_values(converted))`. n ≤ 8 ⇒ ZERO heap traffic; n > 8 ⇒ one exact-size spill (today's behavior, rare by the census). The re-entrancy discipline is preserved IDENTICALLY (stack buffer fully materialized before the arena borrow); `SmallVec`'s by-value `IntoIter` carries the same exact `size_hint` as `Vec`'s ⇒ `alloc_extend` reserves identically; same iteration order, same items, same arena result ⇒ value-identical by construction, byte-identical serialization. The debug census counters in the arm are untouched (the post-M3 census stays comparable).
- **Inline capacity 8, stack-depth soundness:** 192 B inline + ~16 B header per ACTIVE conversion frame (vs `Vec`'s 24 B header); conversion recursion depth ≤ AST nesting depth (`nest_80` ≈160 nested frames ⇒ +~30 KB) — regex parses run the dedicated-stack lane, and the ALL-11 equivalence suite runs large-stack debug workers = the deep-grammar (SV/VHDL) oracle. **📌 MEMBER-5 DESIGN — TRACE-OFF RULE-CONTEXT TRAFFIC (`PGEN-RGX-0078-0175`, design-only; status: `done`; implementation leaf `-0176` measured-falsified + reverted).** Owns the `-0174` NEXT pointer before any implementation. **Goal:** stop maintaining `SemanticRuntimeState::current_rule_context_stack` on ordinary trace-off generated/interpreted parses while preserving the full WHO/WHERE chain byte-for-byte whenever a consumer can observe it. The reader audit remains decisive: the stack's only live reader is `rule_context_path()`, and every live read feeds a `High`/`Debug` trace site; `current_rule_context()` has zero repo callers. The hot population is the current generated/interpreter `push_rule_context_static` path (≈130 entry pairs per 8-pattern bench parse); the allocating legacy `push_rule_context(&str)` API is explicitly OUT of the optimization and retains its unconditional semantics for previously-generated/external callers.

⛔ **DESIGN CORRECTION BEFORE CODE — a process-wide `OnceLock<bool>` is UNSOUND.** The `-0174` pointer proposed the P-env process-once pattern, but `set_global_trace_verbosity(...)` is a public mutable setter and is called by every `RustASTPipeline::new`, the CLI/probes, and tests. Freezing the first observed trace state would make later `None → High` transitions silently lose rule-context traces (or retain hot-path traffic after `High → None`). The safe lib-only design is instead a **per-outermost-transaction latch** inside `SemanticRuntimeState`: add `static_rule_context_depth: usize` and `static_rule_context_tracking: bool`; on the first `push_rule_context_static` at depth 0, sample `trace_enabled(TraceLevel::High)` once, increment depth on every nested static push, and push the `Cow::Borrowed` name only while the latch is true. `pop_rule_context` recognizes the static depth, conditionally pops, decrements, and clears the latch at depth 0; when static depth is zero it keeps the legacy unconditional pop paired with `push_rule_context(&str)`. This samples once per parse/call tree (not ≈130 times), preserves trace reconfiguration between parses, and makes a concurrent/mid-parse verbosity change take effect only at the next outermost transaction so push/pop symmetry cannot corrupt the chain. Low/Medium do not need the stack because every live reader is High/Debug.

**Compatibility/contract:** `push_rule_context(&str)` + `pop_rule_context()` + `current_rule_context()` keep their explicit manual semantics. `push_rule_context_static` is documented as the generated/interpreter diagnostic fast path and becomes trace-latched; no generated artifact or public parser signature changes, so this remains LIB-ONLY and requires NO regen. High/Debug trace output, including nested `rule_context_path()` strings, must be byte-identical. Trace `None`/`Low`/`Medium` must leave the static stack empty after every call tree. Reusing one state across `None → High → None` between outermost calls must enable/disable tracking correctly. A mid-tree verbosity flip must not unbalance the stack and applies on the next outermost call.

**Verification and land/revert adjudication (pre-registered):** focused semantic-runtime tests first; full lib suite including all-11 differential equivalence; regex cert seeds 0/7/42; PCRE2 tuple; AST-shape + duality + source-strict clippy; then the alternated fat-LTO+mimalloc 5×2000 A/B against preserved floor probe `1d3fa0ee`, one heavy job at a time under the 16,384 MB memory guard. No speed band is invented from entry counts. The mechanism is **falsified and the code reverted** if the candidate fails any correctness/trace contract, regresses the settled corpus MAX above 483,583 ns, or improves the 8-pattern geomean by less than the measured 2.28% same-binary noise span (candidate/base ratio > 0.9772). A measurable ≥2.28% improvement with the battery green lands and banks only the measured bundle delta. The implementation is ONE leaf/unit; no unrelated BATCH-1 member is admitted.

   parser's `coverage_enabled` flag (the outcome dump's existing opt-in ⇒ ordinary parsing pays nothing;
   unset ⇒ byte-identical by construction). ENGINE-owned deliberately: the registry dump reads it through
   the EXISTING emitted `semantic_runtime_state()` accessor, so NO new generated-parser API is required and
   the canonical `make focus_*` toolchain (which embeds the previous generation's parsers) keeps compiling —
   the `.5.i.1.t1` chicken-and-egg/bootstrap-drift trap is structurally avoided. All 10 makeable parsers
   regenerated canonically (`make focus_*` ×8 + the two bootstrap-canonical annotation-parser targets); diff
   audit: EVERY parser's diff is EXACTLY the 3 hit-path insertions (7 lines). `generated/ebnf.rs` was found
   a generation STALE (pre-P0 vintage — still `push_rule_context`, never regenerated since `.5.i.2`;
   compiled only via the P0 compatibility shim) and was re-regenerated via its canonical recipe (Rust
   frontend Step B + generated-parsers `ast_pipeline` Step C, make-identical `../generated/` paths) — now
   at HEAD codegen; the equivalence gate is the behavior tripwire.
2. `--dump-rule-outcome-counts-json` extended: `rule_memo_hit_counts` + `total_memo_hits`
   (`raw − hits` = a rule's body executions). Old dump files stay loadable (serde default ⇒ zero hits).
3. `--report-fusibility-census` extended with the **INLINE-CENSUS**: per rule, the P1 gates (a) acyclic
   (`rule_reaches_itself` over the reference digraph — the recursion guard is load-bearing only on a

#### `.5.i.4` P1a EMISSION DESIGN (session #112, 2026-07-13 — recorded BEFORE emission; scope decisions on the STEP-0 numbers)

- **Shared decision, no census/codegen drift (the P2 `first_set.rs` precedent):** the gates (a)–(d)
  verdict AND the emission budget live in `fusibility_census.rs` as pure pub functions
  (`rule_inline_verdict`, `compute_inline_decisions`); the census reports them, codegen consumes them.
  The cycle fact and reference/occurrence counts use the census's OWN collectors — one implementation.
- **Budget (measured, not guessed):** `decided(R) = eligible(R) ∧ weight(R) ≤ 12 ∧
  weight(R)×sites(R) ≤ 192`, where `weight` = capped-transitive expansion computed bottom-up over the
  (provably acyclic) eligible subgraph and `sites` = grammar-wide reference occurrences. Basis: a
  gen-AST weight model over fresh STEP-0-pin-reproducing outcome dumps (2389/617/568 byte-exact):
  uncapped inlining costs ×4.2–14 emitted-body growth (regex) and intolerable SV growth (base 68.9MB);
  at T=12/C=192 the model says regex ×1.75 (+~1.7k body nodes) with **1179/2389 = 49% bench-entry
  exposure**, SV ×1.73, vhdl ×2.11, ebnf ×1.89. Over-budget eligible rules are LOGGED at codegen (no
  silent caps). **Re-priced falsifiable P1a expectation at this budget: ≈ −5.5–7%** (49% of the
  −9–11% frame-elision ceiling + the full needs_raw fold), decided by land-iff-faster.
- **Emission via ONE emitted engine helper** (`inlined_frame_call(rule_id, rule_name, neg_case,
  neg_strict, f)`) carrying the preserved per-frame observability VERBATIM — entry `fetch_add`,
  coverage push, furthest-position, `memoized_call` (memo PRESERVED), and the method-identical
  ✅/⚠️/❌ exit trace lines + negative-case recording — so an inlined site duplicates ONLY the child
  body and the observability protocol exists once (structurally drift-free). Emitted only when ≥1
  rule is decided.
- **Identical-by-construction body:** the method's `rule_body_inner` construction is factored into
  `generate_rule_body_inner(...)`, used by BOTH the rule method and the inlined call site; the call
  site wraps it as `|parser| { let start_pos = parser.position; #body }` (provably the method's
  binding — `memoized_call`'s miss path does not move `position` before running `f`).
- **needs_raw ride-along fold:** when the ANALYSIS annotation table (the P2 `OnceCell` copy of the
  SAME compiled resolution the parser burns in) proves `needs_raw_post/final == false` for a rule,
  the body head emits `let semantic_capture_raw_for_post = false;` instead of the two FxHash probes —
  legal for EVERY directive-free rule, method and inline alike; analysis-table compile failure keeps
  the probes (sound default).
- **Elided at inlined frames (all proven trace-/error-payload-only):** recursion-guard enter/exit
  (gate (a): acyclic ⇒ `check_cycle` keys on the rule's OWN name — absent frames of OTHER names
  cannot change Infinite/LeftRecursive verdicts; `parse_stack` labels are trace-only, and
  `try_parse`'s rollback label may name the parent — the documented V2-class delta), rule-context
  push/pop (every `rule_context_path` consumer sits inside `pgen_trace_high!` — outcome-neutral),
  the `--trace-rules` scope probe (an inlined child's name no longer activates scoping — documented
  trace-only delta), and the method call frame. NAMED residual risk: the recursion-depth ceiling
  (`parse_stack.len() ≥ 4096`) now counts fewer frames per logical descent (bounded: eligible rules
  are acyclic, so between two cycle-rule frames at most one bounded acyclic chain is elided);
  ceiling-adjacent inputs are adjudicated by the corpus real-tuple check in the battery.

#### `.5.i.4` P1b EMISSION DESIGN + FIRST-CONTACT IDENTITY (session #113, 2026-07-13 — design recorded with first-contact measurements, BEFORE the speed verdict)

**The change (surgical by construction):** the emitted `inlined_frame_call` helper's dispatch —
`self.memoized_call(rule_id, f).map(|(node, _raw)| node)` → `f(self).map(|(node, _raw)| node)`.
The regenerated `regex_parser.rs` whole-file diff vs the P1a artifact is EXACTLY this one hunk
(sha `43f91b59…` → `009e1485…`). Entry `fetch_add`, coverage push, furthest-position, exit trace
lines, negative-case recording all stay verbatim; the rule METHOD keeps its `memoized_call`
untouched (method-path memoization intact for entry-relative parsing and ineligible callers).
**Result-neutrality argument (why by construction):** the memo is a PURE, taint-gated cache —
replay ≡ re-execution wherever a replay was legal (`MEMO-STORE-SOUNDNESS.2` is precisely the
proof that stale replays are evicted; the eligible subgraph is additionally directive-free and
acyclic by gates (a)/(b)). A former hit re-executes the budget-capped body whose non-decided
children keep their own memoized methods; furthest-position is a global max over territory the
insert-time execution already explored at the SAME position (the memo key includes position).
Failure-path errors propagate the body's live error instead of the fail-set's synthesized
`Backtrack{key.1}` — caller `try_parse` semantics identical; error PAYLOAD deltas on rejected
parses are trace/diagnostic-only (V2-class, documented).
**FIRST-CONTACT IDENTITY (debug candidate vs P1a, before any speed spend):**
- 8/8 bench AST dumps BYTE-IDENTICAL (`cmp` exact).
- Per-rule COMMITTED counts byte-identical on ALL 8 patterns (aggregate 617 unchanged) — exactly

- Memo hits 568 → 314: the 324 decided-frame hits VANISH (no probes at inlined sites); +70
  child-level hits APPEAR (re-executed bodies probe their children's method memos, which replay
  answered silently under P1a). Two-way accounting, both directions truthful.
- regex cert seeds 0/7/42 `--count 40`: pins BYTE-IDENTICAL
  (`total=267 proof=9 witness=258 UNKNOWN=0 fully_certified=true`), spf `0/1/1` = baseline.

**The instrument (landed this step, read-only analysis — no codegen/parse-behavior change):**
`--report-fusibility-census` extended with the per-site DEGENERACY classification

terminal's first byte extractable, via the shared `first_set` module); per site, the P2 gate verdict

and effect facts queried against the SAME compiled runtime-annotation table the generated parser
consults, never re-derived). New output lines `DEGENERACY-CENSUS:` (+ blocker histogram, top-level
sites) and — with the outcome-counts join — `DEGENERACY-EXPOSURE:` (raw/committed/discarded entries
on rules whose top-level site qualifies; each rule counted once). 3 new unit tests (qualified

naming); 9/9 module tests green.

#### `.5.i.2` — P0 LAZY/NO-ALLOC PROTOCOL HYGIENE RESULTS (session #109, 2026-07-13): LANDED — geomean **−25.8%** (≈56.7µs → ≈42.0µs), byte-identical, observability-preserving

**The change (parser-agnostic; engine + codegen + interpreter; all parsers inherit):**
- **(a) LAZY rollback naming (the V2 surface, measured −14.7%):** new `RollbackLabel<'a>` enum
  (`semantic_runtime.rs`, `Copy` — pointers + integers only) + `rollback_to_labeled(checkpoint, label)`;
  `rollback_to_named` is now a thin wrapper (`Str`/`Unspecified`) kept for compatibility. The generated
  `try_parse` Err arm captures the owning rule as a FREE `Option<&'static str>` copy from `parse_stack`
  (which has been `Vec<(&'static str, usize)>` since RGX-0073) and passes `RollbackLabel::TryParseErr`;
  the C3-B per-successful-branch cleanup passes `RollbackLabel::C3bBranchCleanup{rule,branch,total}`.
  `materialize()` runs ONLY inside the trace-enabled branch of `rollback_to_labeled` (the whole label+chain
  block is now explicitly gated on `trace_enabled(High)`), and reproduces the previous eager strings
  byte-for-byte. Kills 2×`String` per failed speculation + 1×`format!` per successful tournament branch
  (2676 rollbacks/bench).
- **(b) No-Vec branch order + conditional partition-group (the V3 surface, measured −6.5%):** the
  multi-branch tournament emission (`generate_or_logic`) now iterates `(evaluation_step + offset) %
  branch_count` directly — provably the `rotate_left(offset)` sequence, identity order when offset=0 —
  instead of collecting an `evaluation_order: Vec<usize>` per Or-body execution; and
  `effective_deterministic_partition_group` (an unconditional String per Or-body — `.to_string()`/`format!`)
  is now computed ONLY inside the effectively-enabled branch. Behavior identical under ALL runtime modes
  (AnnotationDriven/ForceEnabled/ForceDisabled — the runtime check is preserved, unlike the per-rule-entry
  partition-event elision which is annotation-gated at codegen).
- **(c) No-alloc rule-context stack (the V1 surface, measured −4.3%):** `current_rule_context_stack` is now
  `Vec<Cow<'static, str>>`; new `push_rule_context_static(&'static str)` pushes `Cow::Borrowed` — used by
  the emitted rule IIFE/transaction helper (whose `rule_name` param is now `&'static str`; every call site
  passes the rule-name literal) AND by the interpreter (its names are already interned `&'static str`), so
  BOTH parse paths push allocation-free. The allocating `push_rule_context(&str)` is KEPT
  signature-compatible — deliberately, so the canonical `make focus_*` regen toolchain (which embeds the
  PREVIOUS generation's parsers) still compiles: a breaking signature would have forced the non-canonical
  bootstrap regen that caused the `.5.i.1.t1` null→"null" drift incident. V4/V5 stay OUT per the
  observability doctrine (P3 decides per-region later).

**Baseline identity note (MEMORY drift corrected):** the on-disk release probe at session start was a STALE
pre-regen build (sha `a6bf0553…` — it predated the `.5.i.1` post-incident canonical regen); rebuilding from
clean HEAD reproduced the recorded canonical baseline sha `d43bc6a0…` BIT-FOR-BIT (deterministic build
confirmed) and its geomean ≈55.8µs (2000/200) reproduces the pinned ≈56.7µs. MEMORY.md's ON-DISK note now
names the candidate build.

**Emission spot-check (regenerated `regex_parser.rs`):** `push_rule_context_static` ×214 / allocating
remnants 0 / `TryParseErr` ×1 / `C3bBranchCleanup` ×993 / eager `format!` remnants 0 /
`rotate_left`+`evaluation_order` 0 / modulo-order present.

≈10–14ns annotation-table probes + ≈12–14ns serde (amortized) + ≈5–8ns expression interpretation +
≈10–14ns node build + ≈40–55ns structural parse work.

**⇒ P0–P4 CEILINGS + THE BUILD ORDER FIXED BY MEASUREMENT:**

| pass | surface (measured/derived) | falsifiable ceiling | analysis needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| **P0 (NEW) — lazy/no-alloc protocol hygiene** | V1+V2+V3: trace-naming payloads built eagerly for a trace that is off; Vec built to iterate 0..n | **≈−25%** (compose ≈0.763 + synergy; observability-PRESERVING: materialize names lazily only when trace consumes them) | **NONE** — plain engineering, all parsers inherit |

**Recommended order: P0 → P2 → P1 → P3 → P4** — P0 first (no analysis, biggest cheap win, shrinks

   `transactional_parse_coverage_wiring_is_emitted_at_codegen` needle). All 11 parsers REGENERATED (debug regen via

   (macro-shared expansion with the `.5.h.1` dump; regex worker-thread capture mirrored; opt-in thread-local,
   unset ⇒ coverage stays disabled ⇒ byte-identical behavior).

   encodable-branch subset via the `.5.h.1` shape classifier, per-branch text tier, sole-reference attribution) +
   `--fusibility-outcome-counts F1,…` join → `OUTCOME-SHARE` (committed/discarded × encodable/structural
   decomposition + per-site sole-attributable discards). 2 new unit tests (mixed-site classification + join
   decomposition; 6/6 module tests green).

**Cross-validations (the instrument agrees with every independent prior measurement):**

  215 committed = 1045 entries ⇒ 2389/1344 ≈ **1.78×** — the SAME 1045/≈1.8× the `.5.h.1` entry-share computed

**THE MEASURED VERDICT (8-pattern bench, uniform per-entry cost model):**
```
OUTCOME-SHARE: grammar=regex files=8 total_entries=2389 committed=617 discarded=1773
               (on_encodable=830 on_structural=943) committed_on_encodable=215 ceiling≈1.53x
```

#### `.5.h.1.t1` — the `spf 0/1/1` residual ADJUDICATED (session #107, 2026-07-13): label gap FIXED; over-generation ORACLE-CLASSIFIED

**(a) The FAILURE-LABEL gap — FIXED (one-line registry wiring).**
- WHY+WHERE: `parse_error()` (`parser_registry.rs:912`) dispatches through the registry entry's `parse_detail`
  hook; the regex entry had `parse_detail: None` (never wired when G.4.7 added the hook per-grammar — only
  SV/svpp/scratch were wired), so `main.rs`'s cert failure-labeler fell back to
  `"(no detail-capable parser registered)"`. The existing `parse_with_regex_detail` already has the exact
  `ParseDetailFn` signature.
- FIX: `parse_detail: Some(parse_with_regex_detail)` (+ the semantic note: the detail fn's PCRE2 compile
  contract never runs on this pathway — it is only consulted for samples whose grammar parse failed, where the
  deterministic re-parse fails before the contract).
- Before → after (seed 7): `[0] error: (no detail-capable parser registered)` →
  `[0] error: Parser did not consume full input at position 90`. Cert headline byte-identical
  (`total=267 proof=9 witness=258 UNKNOWN=0 fully_certified=true`, spf unchanged).

**(b) The 117-byte over-generation — ORACLE-CLASSIFIED as the \Q-quoting ROUND-TRIP-ABSORPTION class (gen-side; the parser is RIGHT).**
- The sample's tail is `…(*PRUNE)|(?(51)\Q\Q\Q)*?^\Q3 T 8é\E`. Position 90 = the `(` of the conditional. The
  `\Q` opened after `(?(51)` quotes to the FIRST following `\E` — which is the FINAL `\E` of the pattern — so the
  conditional's closing `)` (and `*?^…`) are absorbed as quoted literal content and the group never closes.
- **PCRE2 oracle verdict (pcre2test 10.47, the exact sample):** `Failed: error 114 at offset 117: missing
  closing parenthesis` — PCRE2 quotes the same way and rejects. The parser's reject is PCRE2-FAITHFUL
  (accept/reject parity holds); the defect is that the GENERATOR emitted the pattern: a quoted-literal piece
  generated inside a conditional whose rendered text, on re-parse, absorbs the enclosing group's structural
  close. Same class as the svpp `H.5.5` round-trip hazard; the gen-side-has-no-`lacks_fact`-prune family
  ([[project_gen_side_no_lacks_fact_branch_prune]] — structural grammar peel is the preferred fix shape).
- **Adjudication: DOCUMENTED-TRACKED, fix DEFERRED.** The structural fix (position-restricting the
  quoted-literal/unterminated-quoting forms so generated content cannot absorb following structural text) is
  regex.ebnf surgery with a full-battery + book/contract lockstep cost, while the residual is bounded and stable
  (spf ≤1 per seed, unchanged across sessions #91–#107) and the §G.1 road pick pending with the director owns
  regex priorities. The ⛔ battery continues to hold spf-NEUTRALITY vs the `0/1/1` baseline; this class re-opens
  as its own leaf if the residual ever grows or the director prioritizes duality-tightening.
